title: Staff Database Engineer
description:
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.
  
  
TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.
  
  
**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium-size customers. So if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.**
**A Brief Overview**
The Staff Database Engineer is responsible for managing, monitoring and maintaining assigned databases and their operating system/CPU/memory/storage resources, as well as to ensure availability and performance complies with TriNet's expectations. This position is also responsible for overseeing database operations of the TriNet hosting production and non-production environments.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Provide engineering, installation, configuration, maintenance and support in a 24/7 environment
* Monitor designated applications and take corrective action to prevent or minimize system downtime.
* Build /create / refresh / move databases as required.
* Configure solutions for High Availability, Load balancing and fail over support.
* Secure all databases by developing system access, monitoring, control, and evaluation.
* AWS services, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) services, Terraform, Github, Gitlab.
* Install/Upgrade database software, patches for Oracle, MySql, PostgreSQL Databases
* Deep understanding of AWS services related to databases highly desirable, particularly Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora
* Database DevOps Automation and adoption using Terraform, CloudFormation
* Strong knowledge of AWS Services like EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, Aurora, API Gateway, SNS & DMS
* Strong Experience with Data Migration tools like Goldengate, DMS, FiveTran
* Apply engineering knowledge, Database Observability tools and processes to identify/prevent/reduce the frequency or likelihood of potential issues
* Work closely with software engineering teams to review application design and code frequently to ensure that standards are being adhered to
* Work closely with database vendors to seek support for technical issues.
* Provide technical solutions and escalated support for highly complex technical issues.
* Develop and analyze highly complex system standards, thresholds, and recommendations to maximize system performance.
* Maintain documentation on physical and logical layout and assets of the technical architectures to maximize availability and reliability.
* Implement changes into production environments to support change management and release scheduling.
* Other projects and responsibilities may be added at the manager’s discretion.
* Performs other duties as assigned
* Complies with all policies and standards

**Education Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience preferred

**Experience Qualifications**

* Typically 10+ years of relevant experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect Associate/Professional)
* Experience with microservices and serverless architecture
* Exposure to monitoring and logging tools

**Skills And Abilities**

* Experience in HR Services industry preferred.
* Strong ITIL principles a plus.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent Teamwork
* Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of management, both verbally and in writing
* Strong working knowledge on Oracle Support processes for technical requests resolution
* Strong Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office skills
* Ability to coordinate with multiple IT and Business stakeholders.
* Ability to efficiently work on multiple complex projects or assignments concurrently.
* Ability to think logically and analytically.
* Knowledge of Privileged Access Management tools like BeyondTrust, SailPoint etc.

**Work Environment**

* Work in a clean, pleasant, and comfortable office work setting. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* This position is 100% in office.

Please Note: TriNet reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. The above job description is not all encompassing. Position functions and qualifications may vary depending on business necessity.
  
  
TriNet is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against applicants based on race, religion, color, disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), age, veteran status or other legally protected characteristics. Any applicant with a mental or physical disability who requires an accommodation during the application process should contact India\_Recruitment@Trinet.com to request such an accommodation.

title: Senior System Analyst, Managed Services
description:
Date: Oct 14, 2026
  
  
Location:
  
  
Hyderabad, TG, IN, 500032
  
  
Functional Area: Remote
  
  
Syntax is a leading Managed Cloud Provider for Mission Critical Enterprise Applications and has been providing comprehensive technology solutions to businesses of all sizes since 1972. Syntax has undisputed strength to implement and manage ERP deployments (Oracle, SAP) in a secure and resilient private, public or hybrid cloud. With strong technical and functional consulting services, and world-class monitoring and automation, Syntax serves some of North America’s largest corporations across a diverse range of industries. Syntax has offices worldwide, and partners with Oracle, SAP, AWS, Microsoft, IBM and other global technology leaders.
  
  
Greetings from Syntax (https://www.syntax.com).
  
  
We have an Urgent requirement for the position of Senior Microsoft SQL Server DBA
  
  
**Job Type: Permanent**
**Experience: 8+years**
**Location: Remote-India**
**Job Title: Senior Microsoft SQL Server DBA**
**Shift Timings: This position will work Rotational shifts (Morning, Afternoon IST Hours)**
**Position Summary**
Reporting to the Manager of DBA Operations, the individual will be fully responsible for all technical matters related to Microsoft SQL Server databases, including but not limited to installation, upgrades, high availability/disaster recovery, performance tuning, security, and coordinating/executing all code and data migrations across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Should have deep, hands-on expertise administering Microsoft SQL Server (2016 through 2022) in enterprise, multi-customer environments.
* Must have advanced experience with SQL Server High Availability/Disaster Recovery technologies such as Always On Availability Groups, Failover Clustering, Log Shipping, and Replication.
* Install, configure, and maintain SQL Server instances on-premises and on cloud platforms such as AWS RDS/EC2 and Azure SQL/Managed Instance.
* Perform database refreshes, schema/table refreshes, and creation/management of logins, users, roles, and permissions.
* Perform backup, restore, and point-in-time recovery (PITR) of databases, including validation of backup integrity.
* Monitor database performance using native and third-party tools; identify and resolve blocking, deadlocking, and query performance issues.
* Perform index maintenance, statistics updates, and query/execution plan tuning.
* Lead and execute SQL Server patching and version upgrade activities with minimal downtime.
* Participate in and lead disaster recovery (DR) planning, testing, and execution for customer environments.
* Configure and maintain SQL Server Agent jobs, alerts, and automated maintenance plans.
* Implement and maintain database security, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), Row-Level Security, and auditing.
* Work with development and application teams on database design review, capacity planning, and migration projects.
* Open and manage support cases with Microsoft, AWS, and/or Azure as needed.
* Work in flexible shifts as demanded by project or on-call requirements.
* Communicate regularly and professionally with clients via email and phone.
* Work within a ticketing tool (e.g., ServiceNow) to track and resolve incidents and requests.
* Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced, multi-client environment.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of strong, hands-on experience as a SQL Server DBA, supporting installation, configuration, administration, and performance tuning in production environments.
* Proven experience with Always On Availability Groups, Failover Clustering, Log Shipping, Replication, and Mirroring.
* Experience administering SQL Server in cloud environments such as AWS RDS/EC2 and/or Azure SQL Database/Managed Instance is highly desirable.
* Strong experience with backup and recovery strategies, including native backups, third-party tools (e.g., Redgate, Quest LiteSpeed), and PITR.
* Solid experience with performance monitoring and tuning, including execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, and wait-statistics analysis.
* Experience with SQL Server security hardening, TDE, auditing, and compliance requirements.
* Working knowledge of PowerShell and T-SQL scripting for automation of routine DBA tasks.
* Experience with SSIS, SSRS, and/or SSAS is a plus.
* Experience supporting ERP or other mission-critical enterprise applications on SQL Server a plus.
* Experience working in a managed-services or offshore/onshore delivery model supporting multiple customers concurrently.
* Familiarity with monitoring tools such as SolarWinds, SentryOne/SQL Sentry, or Redgate Monitor a plus.
* Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills for issues arising from day-to-day production operations.
* Ability to work independently and interact effectively with diverse teams (application, network, infrastructure, and business users).
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, MCSE: Data Management and Analytics, or equivalent certification a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Why Syntax?**
Become a part of our success story and work in a company with exciting innovation projects that are causing a stir across the industry. We recently launched one of the world's most advanced manufacturing facilities based on SAP S/4HANA Cloud and SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud for Execution - for Smart Press Shop, a pioneering joint venture between Porsche and forming specialist Schuler.
  
  

* Competitive, above-average compensation
* Global tourist: With us, you can also work from abroad from time to time
* Flexible working time models, home office
* Attractive benefits, e.g. company pension scheme or various health offers
* A modern environment in which the "you" is part of it
* Open feedback culture, flat hierarchies and a motivated team
* Individual career planning with continuous training and coaching on the job

You see a personal challenge in this responsible task? Apply now - and become part of the SYNTAX team!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

You'll build on top of Saras IQ Product to own the solution and the build for a client requirement - from the first requirements conversation and live customer demos to validated data, one trusted set of metrics, live dashboards, and clean data every morning - as the accountable owner of what gets built as a repeatable product capability.

**About Saras Analytics**

Saras Analytics is an AI and data analytics firm built for ecommerce and omnichannel brands. We help fast growing SMBs and mid-market brands turn disconnected, messy data into decisions — covering ingestion, transformation, and consumption, backed by our own products (Daton and Saras IQ) as the data infrastructure in every engagement.

**Why Now**

Saras is profitable and bootstrapped. We run flat: talent and good ideas move fast here regardless of tenure or title. AI-assisted tooling now lets one engineer take a client from the first requirements conversation to a live, trusted dashboard without waiting on a queue of hand-offs. The Forward Deployed Engineer role is built around that: one owner, end to end, with the tooling to make it fast. Because you build on top of our products rather than around them, what you create for one client requirement becomes capability that every client can use. An FDE joining now helps define what that role looks like at its best.

**The Role**

You'll own the solution and the build for one client account, reporting to an FDE Lead. You build on top of our product, Saras IQ, extending it with software you design and code. You are responsible for interacting directly with the customer — running discovery, demoing what you build, and presenting it to client stakeholders — as well as with the product teams, and you contribute to the product roadmap. Whatever you build, you then become the advisor or implementer of that same capability in the product: you create repeatable solutions that expand what the product can do and maximize revenue impact. On that account you work alongside a Strategic Account Manager, who owns the client relationship and the commercial outcomes, and a Product Manager, who owns product onboarding, enablement, and roadmap, with you as a direct contributor to it. You own what gets built and whether it is right — requirements, software, data, metrics, dashboards, and data quality — with our AI-assisted tooling and our SME leads behind you for the hardest problems.

**The Bar**

Speed & Delivery quality are the top priorities for this role: what you ship is correct, validated against the source of truth before the client sees it, and there on the date you committed to. Speed matters because clients feel it — the shortest path from signed-off requirements to a live, trusted dashboard — but never at the cost of numbers the client can rely on. You build to product standard: what you write is well designed, tested, version-controlled, and reusable, because it is part of the product. You surface risks before they block delivery, and you close every issue with a root cause and a fix, you internally escalate the dependencies on time. The lanes are explicit: you own the solution and the build; the Account Manager owns the relationship and the commercial outcomes; the Product Manager owns product onboarding, enablement, and roadmap, with you as a direct contributor to it.

**What You'll Own**

**1. Own discovery and requirements.**
Join the sales handover to close open questions and call out risks early. Run discovery sessions directly with client stakeholders on the client's core use cases — sales and marketing, contribution margin, customer cohorts, product and inventory — co-design the solution with them, and write the business requirements and metric definitions using Saras' standard templates, reviewing them internally before client sign-off. Build the mock-ups that let clients react before anything is built, demo working builds live to the client at every milestone and take their feedback directly, write the test cases every requirement will be validated against, and track change requests so scope stays visible to you and the Account Manager.

**2. Own the data build.**
Set up integrations and access with our data-ingestion team, translate requirements into technical specifications, and build the staging, master, and presentation datasets with Saras' AI-assisted data-engineering tools, following our data-model conventions (dbt, BigQuery, Git). Apply PII masking, and keep the data dictionary and lineage documentation current. When a problem goes beyond your account — a complex architecture choice or a platform limit — take it to the senior data-engineering lead with a proposed workaround, and keep ownership of the outcome.

**3. Build on top of the product, end to end.**
You are not only modelling data: you build complete solutions on top of Saras IQ, and that takes software & data engineering & Analytics skills. Design and code the services, APIs, integrations, automation, and application logic around the data layer, and apply sound engineering practice — modular design, code review, automated tests, version control, and CI/CD. Write code that others can maintain and extend, because it may become part of the product.

**4. Turn what you build into product.**
Whatever you build, you become the advisor or implementer of that same capability in the product. Package it as a repeatable, configurable solution rather than a one-off, document it, and help other FDEs and accounts adopt it, so each engagement expands what the product can do and maximizes its revenue impact.

**5. Own the client's metric definitions.**
Configure one certified set of metrics and dimensions for each client in Saras IQ's semantic layer, so that every dashboard, self-serve question, and AI answer draws on the same definitions.

**6. Own validation before anything reaches the client**
. Reconcile every dataset against its source of truth, certify it, and run the internal sign-off against agreed criteria for sending work back. Set up the data quality and completeness checks, validate against the requirement test cases and against a benchmark set of business questions the AI analyst must answer correctly, then walk the Account Manager through the build in a final review before it goes to the client.

**7. Own the consumption layer.**
Build dashboards natively in Saras IQ (and in Tableau, Luzmo, or Power BI where the contract specifies), drawing their metrics from the client's certified definitions. Build and maintain the business context that powers Saras IQ Analyst, our AI analyst; set it up and provision it for client users in Slack and their AI tools; and keep refining that context from what users ask it. The Account Manager leads the launch and adoption, and the Product Manager leads enablement.

**8. Own data quality every day.**
Run the daily data-quality cycle: confirm the overnight pipelines and checks have completed, resolve what they flag, escalate anything still open — or late upstream data — to the senior data-engineering lead, re-run and re-test what you fixed, and send the client a routine data-quality status (with any help you need from them), copying the Account Manager. Configure latency and dashboard alerts, and close every bug and change request with a root cause and a fix. When an issue breaches its SLA or stays open past a day, the Account Manager takes the client escalation and you drive the fix.

**9. Run your delivery hygiene.**
Keep your onboarding and project documentation, task tracker, and timesheets current, so anyone can see where your account stands.

**10. Partner across the lanes.**
Be the direct technical voice to customers and to the product teams, and contribute to the product roadmap. Support your Account Manager with the technical answers behind success criteria, client acceptance testing, and adoption, and demo what you built and walk client users through its logic yourself, while the Account Manager owns the relationship and the commercial conversations; work with the Product Manager and the product teams to turn what you hear from customers and learn from your builds into roadmap priorities; and work with our data-ingestion and data-engineering teams to unblock ingestion, data quality, and architecture issues.

**What Winning Looks Like**

**First 90 days:**

you know your account's data and metric definitions in depth, you run the daily data-quality cycle reliably, and you've taken at least one deliverable from signed-off requirements to a validated, live dashboard on your own, demoing it to the client yourself.

**Steady state:**

you deliver datasets and dashboards independently and on the committed date, your validation catches issues before clients ever do, your client's mornings start with clean data, your FDE Lead trusts what you ship without re-checking every number, your teammates enjoy working with you, what you've built is reusable and part of the product, you contribute to the roadmap, and you're ready to own a new account launch end to end.

**Who Thrives Here**

Any of these backgrounds can get you in the room. Across all of them, you bring 3+ years (typically 3–6) of hands-on data and software work — some of it building in SQL and code, and some of it facing clients, including demos.

• You've been a business or data analyst who wrote requirements and specifications, worked hands-on in SQL, and are ready to own the build as well as the brief.

• You've been an analytics or data engineer who built layered data models — raw, staging, masters, presentation — and are ready to own the client conversation as well as the pipeline.

• You've delivered data or BI projects in an analytics consulting or services firm, end to end, directly with clients.

• You've been a software engineer who built backend or full-stack applications and data-heavy products, and are ready to take on analytics, data modelling, and the client conversation.

**Whichever route you come from, you have:**

• A degree from a reputed engineering college.

• Strong SQL and data-modelling fundamentals across the raw → staging → master → presentation layers.

• Software engineering fundamentals: proficiency in Python (or a comparable language such as Java, TypeScript, or Go), data structures, and the ability to write clean, modular, tested, maintainable code.

• Software design skills: you can design the architecture of an end-to-end solution — services, APIs, data flows, and integrations — weigh the trade-offs, and build it to be reusable and extensible.

• Engineering practice: code review, unit and integration testing, CI/CD, and debugging in production. • Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool — Tableau, Power BI, or similar.

• A foundational understanding of statistics — enough to know when a number is meaningful and when it isn't.

• Working knowledge of dbt and BigQuery (or the ability to ramp up quickly), and everyday use of Git.

• Comfort with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, or GitHub Copilot — we'll train you on Saras' own tooling.

• The ability to turn an ambiguous client ask into clear, testable requirements and a technical specification.

• Clear, confident client communication — you can own a delivery conversation without a go-between, run live product demos, and present to client and product stakeholders.

• The ability to work with product teams and contribute to a roadmap: you can turn customer needs and what you've built into reusable product capabilities.

**It's an even stronger fit if you also bring:**

• An engineering degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Analytics, or Data Science.

We are looking for a sharp, technically minded analyst / junior developer with around one year of commercial or practical software engineering experience seeking to build their career designing and coding solutions across the Oracle Cloud ecosystem.

You will work directly alongside senior engineers and technical leads, writing clean, maintainable code, building robust APIs, and solving technical challenges across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Oracle database technologies.

Alongside core cloud engineering, you’ll also be exposed to industry-leading AI agents—which we architect and develop in-house—giving you the opportunity to contribute directly to modern agentic workflows and intelligent automation. * **Agile Engineering Practices:**
  Collaborate actively in daily standups, sprint reviews, and estimation sessions within distributed teams, taking ownership of tasks to hit release milestones.

  **relational databases and SQL**

  **Oracle Database / PL/SQL**

  **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C#**
  , or procedural database languages).
* Clear understanding of web standards and protocols (
  **HTTP methods, REST APIs, JSON/XML, authentication mechanisms**
  ).
* Familiarity with version control using
  **Git**
  (branching, merging, pull requests).
* **Education:**
  Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, STEM discipline, or equivalent demonstrable coding background.
* **Mindset:**
  Strong analytical reasoning and debugging skills, high curiosity about emerging AI and cloud tech, and the initiative and problem-solving skills to independently navigate and resolve complex technical challenges.

**What we offer**

* A collaborative environment with opportunities for growth and mentorship.
* Involvement in innovative cloud and SaaS transformation projects.
* Flexible working options and supportive team culture.
* Competitive compensation up to 8 LPA and professional development support.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
****Role Overview****
We are looking for Software Engineers (SE) who can break down and solve complex problems with a strong motivation to get things done with a boots-on-the-ground, pragmatic mindset! Our engineers own their products end to end and influence the way how our products and technology are deployed to facilitate most aspects of drug discovery impacting hundreds of thousands of patients around the world. We are looking for engineers who can creatively handle complex dependencies and ambiguous requirements, competing business priorities, while producing fit-for-purpose, optimal solutions.
  
  
We are hoping that you are passionate about collaborating across the interface between hard-core software development and research and discovery data analysis.
  
  
Our Engineering team builds core components used by our company's Research Labs’ data analytics, visualization, and management workflows. The analysis tools and pipelines built for data processing by our team in partnership with our scientists aim to accelerate research and the discovery of new therapies for our patients.
  
  
We collect, annotate, analyze petabytes of scientific data (multi-omics, chemistry, imaging, safety) used in biomarker research, drug safety/efficacy, drug target discovery, and compendium diagnostic development. We help our scientists to process, analyze scientific data at scale by developing highly parallelized analytical workflows ran on HPC infrastructure (on-prem & cloud); to manage, explore and visualize various scientific data modalities by developing bespoke data models, bioinformatics ETL processes, data retrieval and visualization services using distributed micro-service architecture, FAIR data principles, SPA type dashboards, industry specific regulatory compliant data integrity, auditing, and security access controls.
  
  
We are a creative and disciplined software engineering team, using agile practices and established technology stacks to design and develop large-scale data analytics, visualization, and management software solutions for local and on-cloud hosted HPC datacenters, as well as to integrate 3rd party analytical platforms with internal data workflows to address pressing engineering and data science challenges of life-science.

* BS or MS in Computer Science/engineering or equivalent technical field.
* 3 to 6 years of experience in Cloud Data Engineering.

****Required Skills****

* Proficient (3+ years hands-on experience) with Python.
* Proven ability (3+ years hands-on experience).
* Data manipulation using Linux command line tools, batch processing.
* Large data processing, data consistency validation.
* Experience with bioinformation pipeline, data formats (FastQ, BAM) is huge advantage.
* Experience with AWS CLI for data manipulation (aws cli, boto3..).
* Experience with AWS filesystem (s3, efs, ebs).

* Python (3+ years hands-on experience)

* Data Consistency Validation
* Scientific/Data Pipeline Support
* AWS CLI (AWS CLI, Boto3)

We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

Role Summary
  
  
NTT DATA is seeking --years of Web & Middleware Administrator is responsible for installing, configuring, securing, optimizing, and supporting enterprise grade web servers, application servers, and middleware platforms across on premise and cloud environments. This role ensures highly available, scalable, and secure hosting for business applications while collaborating closely with development, security, DevOps, cloud, and infrastructure teams.

* Web Server Administration (Apache HTTP, IBM IHS, NGINX, IIS)

Install, configure, and maintain Apache HTTP, IBM IHS, NGINX, and IIS across Linux/Windows environments.
  
  
Configure virtual hosts, reverse proxies, load balancing, SSL/TLS, mod\_security, mod\_jk/mod\_proxy, WAF rules, and request routing.
  
  
Manage certificates, keystores, aliasing, and automated certificate renewals.
  
  
Implement hardening guidelines (headers, ciphers, rate limits, firewall rules).
  
  
Monitor web traffic patterns, tune performance, and troubleshoot HTTP/HTTPS/SSL issues.

Install, configure, patch, and upgrade Oracle WebLogic, IBM WebSphere, JBoss EAP/WildFly, Apache Tomcat, and Oracle Application Server.

Troubleshoot application issues: classloader conflicts, memory leaks, thread dumps, GC tuning, connection pool bottlenecks.
  
  
Configure multi node clustering, domain creation, admin nodes, managed servers, and load balancers.
  
  
Set up security realms, LDAP/AD integration, JAAS, J2EE/Jakarta EE security policies.

Configure and optimize caching, compression, keep alive, connection handling, request limits, and tuning parameters.
  
  
Monitor JVM performance, GC logs, thread/heap usage, and server KPIs.
  
  
Use monitoring tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Prometheus/Grafana, Splunk/ELK).

Automate server builds, deployments, and configurations using Shell, Python, PowerShell, Ansible, or Jenkins pipelines.
  
  
Integrate web/app servers with CI/CD (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).
  
  
Maintain configuration-as-code for repeatable and compliant deployments.

Implement SSL/TLS, certificate rotation, PKI, keystore/truststore management.
  
  
Apply CIS, OWASP, STIG, and organization hardening benchmarks.
  
  
Manage access controls, RBAC, authentication modules, and secure admin interfaces.
  
  
Patch vulnerabilities, perform upgrades, and support security audits.
  
  

* High Availability, DR & Scalability

Set up clustering & load balancing for WebLogic, WebSphere, JBoss, Tomcat, and NGINX/IHS/IIS.
  
  
Manage horizontal/vertical scaling strategies.
  
  
Build and maintain DR environments, backups, replication, and failover testing.

Manage incident response, RCA, and preventive actions.
  
  
Provide 24×7 on call support (if required).

description:

Our SAP infrastructure is hosted and managed by a third-party hosting/managed-services hosting partner, so this role is heavily focused on technical oversight, working with hosting partner governance, and ensuring the hosting partner executes Basis operations to our standards. This is an equally weighted Basis and Security role: the ideal candidate has deep SAP ECC/HANA Basis expertise and hands-on ownership of SAP security administration, plus proven experience configuring integrations using PI/PO, SFTP, cloud-based integration agents and supporting enterprise archiving workflow.
  
  
**Job Details:**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
SAP Basis Administration (Hosting Partner Environment)
  
  

* Execute and coordinate day-to-day technical operational interactions with the third-party hosting partner for all SAP ECC 6.0 on HANA Basis activities — driving accountability.
* Support patch, kernel upgrade, and support pack revision update, and system enhancement initiatives following established governance and architecture.
* Work with SAP functional and technical teams to support systems refreshes, client copies, transport management, and landscape maintenance.
* Relentlessly monitor SAP ECC/HANA system performance, verify hosting partner SLAs (performance, availability, response times), and escalate issues to internal leadership when standards slip.
* Perform systems performance analysis and capacity trending. Analyze usage patterns, system headroom, and assist in executing database archiving strategies and capacity plans per lead direction.
* Support disaster recovery planning, testing (backup/restore, HANA system replication/HSR, failover), and validation activities to ensure business continuity readiness.

SAP Security Administration
  
  

* Maintain and support the SAP authorization concept — roles, composite roles, profiles, and organizational-level restrictions — across the ECC 6.0/HANA landscape in accordance with established security policies.
* Execute user access lifecycle management, including provisioning, de-provisioning, access recertification, and enforcement of least-privilege principles across all clients and environments (Dev/QA/Prod).
* Drive Perform segregation of duties (SoD) analysis and remediation, proactively identifying and resolving conflicting access before it becomes an audit finding, and maintaining a clean SoD ruleset aligned to business risk.
* Support Internal Audit, InfoSec, and external auditors on all SAP security assessments.
* Proactively monitor for anomalous access patterns, dormant accounts, and emerging authorization risk, bringing forward remediation plans before issues are flagged externally.
* Define, document, and enforce SAP security standards, naming conventions, and role-build methodology, ensuring consistency and auditability across the entire authorization landscape.

Integration Configuration
  
  

* Configure and support of interfaces built on SAP PI/PO (IDoc, RFC, SOAP, REST, File adapters), driving configuration, proactive monitoring, and rapid troubleshooting across every SAP-to-third-party connection.

* Configure, maintain, and support cloud-based integration agents/connectors (e.g., SAP Cloud Connector or equivalent middleware agents), ensuring a secure, reliable bridge between the hosting partner's ECC environment and cloud/third-party applications.
* Guarantee that integration channels remain secure, thoroughly documented, and resilient against disruption from hosting partner-side changes (e.g., patching, network reconfiguration) — anticipating issues before they impact the business.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, India
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
  
  
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.
  
  
**About The Role**
Notion is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer focused on migrations to join our growing team in India. You will help deliver complex, production-grade data migrations, integrations, and automations for customers across APAC.
  
  
This is initially an internally focused, hands-on engineering role. You will partner closely with regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who own customer discovery, solution architecture, stakeholder communication, risk management, and final customer validation. You will own the behind-the-scenes technical execution layer from feasibility assessment and implementation through testing, production rollout, QA, reconciliation, reporting, and operational handoff.
  
  
You will work across multiple customer environments and source systems, often with incomplete requirements, imperfect data, and real-world constraints. Success requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgment, careful validation, and the ability to turn one-off delivery work into reusable tools and repeatable playbooks.
  
  
As a founding engineer in India, you will help build a new regional engineering capability from the ground up. You will create migration infrastructure, standards, and reusable tooling used by FDEs across APAC, while establishing practices that can scale globally. The role offers an opportunity to become a technical authority for production migration delivery, shaping how Notion approaches reliability, validation, and operational quality across complex customer environments. As the team grows, the role may also expand toward customer-facing FDE work, technical leadership, or a deeper engineering path, depending on business needs and demonstrated capability.
  
  
**What You'll Achieve**

* Own the technical execution layer after customer requirements, scope, and solution architecture have been established with the regional FDE. Contribute to feasibility assessment, estimation, implementation planning, and risk identification while the regional FDE remains accountable for customer discovery, scope, architecture, stakeholder communication, and final acceptance.
* Apply a repeatable migration lifecycle covering source inventory and sampling, scope and pruning decisions, compatibility and degradation assessment, transformation design, pilot or dry run, user acceptance testing, production cutover, reconciliation, remediation, hypercare, and documented handoff.
* Translate approved customer and regional FDE requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, test strategies, runbooks, and delivery estimates.
* Build production-quality migration utilities, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and automations using Python, SQL, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
* Investigate source-system behavior, data quality issues, permissions, rate limits, authentication constraints, and edge cases, then recommend practical solutions.
* Design and validate permissions, ownership, and inheritance mappings against the approved migration plan. Make unsupported or ambiguous access requirements explicit, obtain the required decision or approval, and preserve evidence of validation.
* Design migrations for reliability, scale, security, observability, idempotency, failure recovery, and safe reruns.
* Execute migrations only through approved environments, devices, accounts, and tooling. Follow least-privilege access, customer-specific security and data-residency requirements, and approved handling procedures. Do not store customer data in unmanaged local or external systems, and escalate privacy, security, or sovereignty concerns before execution.
* Build validation and reconciliation frameworks that provide clear evidence of migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions.
* Debug failures across application code, infrastructure, customer data, third-party systems, and the Notion platform, then drive issues through resolution.
* Manage multiple implementation workstreams, dependencies, and priorities while communicating scope, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.
* Surface scope changes, unsupported requirements, timeline risks, and material effort increases early. Document assumptions and trade-offs, and escalate with options and a recommended path rather than silently absorbing additional work.
* Maintain an auditable record of scope, decisions, risks, approvals, validation evidence, and customer acceptance criteria in the agreed shared workspace or channel.
* Convert repeated delivery patterns into reusable components, automation, documentation, and playbooks that improve speed, quality, and cost over time.
* Bring field learnings back to Notion's Product and Engineering teams as actionable platform feedback and technical requirements.

**Skills You'll Need To Bring**

* 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in backend engineering, data engineering, integration engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.
* Strong hands-on Python development experience.
* Working experience with Node.js, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data transformation.
* Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, webhooks, and system integrations.
* Experience owning a production migration, integration, or technical implementation through mapping, transformation, testing, rollout, validation, and handoff.
* Experience taking a technical problem from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production operation.
* Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, release practices, and production deployment.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across code, data, infrastructure, and external systems.
* Evidence of working on production systems, not only prototypes or proof-of-concept projects.
* Clear written and verbal English communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions, constraints, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* High agency and ownership. You are comfortable making progress with incomplete information, challenging assumptions, and escalating with options and a recommendation.

**Nice To Haves**

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, job orchestration, or infrastructure automation.
* Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Familiarity with message queues, event-driven systems, distributed-system patterns, retries, concurrency, and rate limits.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, or other observability tools.
* Experience with enterprise SaaS applications, professional services, or large-scale customer implementations.
* Experience migrating large volumes of content or structured data between enterprise platforms.
* Experience with AI or LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, Notion Workers, Custom Agents, or similar extensibility platforms.
* Experience working with distributed global or APAC teams.

**What Success Looks Like**
**In your first 90 days, you will:**

* Learn Notion's migration and implementation ecosystem, engineering standards, and APAC delivery model.
* Establish a productive working rhythm with regional FDE partners.
* Contribute to at least one migration or integration workstream through production delivery.
* Leave behind clear technical documentation, validation evidence, and an operational runbook.

**Within Your First Six Months, You Will**

* Independently own production migration or integration workstreams from technical design through rollout and handoff.
* Deliver measurable improvements in migration turnaround time, validation quality, delivery cost, or regional FDE execution hours through reusable engineering.
* Help establish repeatable quality controls, code review practices, runbooks, and observability patterns for the India team.
* Demonstrate effective prioritization and communication across multiple concurrent APAC engagements.
* Turn at least one repeated delivery pattern into a reusable tool, component, or playbook that is adopted by a subsequent engagement.

title: Executive Manager - Data (Master + Transactional) Quality
description:
**Overview**
The Data (Master & Transactional) Quality Lead will act as a subject matter expert and individual contributor, enforcing Enterprise Data Management standards and governance practices to ensure successful business transformations across SAP S/4HANA programs.
  
  
The role will be responsible for driving end-to-end data quality, migration validation, and reconciliation activities for both Master Data and Transactional Data throughout the migration lifecycle. This includes data readiness assessments, migration quality controls, pre- and post-load validations, defect management, and business sign-off support. The individual will work closely with Data Migration, Functional, Technical, and Business teams to ensure migrated data is complete, accurate, reconciled, and aligned with Global Template standards.
  
  
Experience in SAP S/4HANA Data Migration programs, particularly in data validation and post-migration validation activities, is essential. Exposure to SNP CrystalBridge migration and validation solutions is highly desirable.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead data quality and validation activities across SAP S/4HANA migration programs.
* Define and execute validation strategies for Master Data and Transactional Data throughout mock cycles, dress rehearsals, and production cutovers.
* Partner with Data Migration and Data Validation teams to ensure completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity of migrated data.
* Establish and execute reconciliation frameworks including record counts, financial balancing, business process validations, and exception reporting.
* Manage questions and provide clear direction to development and validation teams during solution build, testing, and deployment phases.
* Monitor data quality metrics, identify issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive remediation activities.
* Work with Global teams to implement new validation patterns, controls, and automation opportunities.
* Maintain overall migration validation trackers, reporting dashboards, and conversion readiness statistics.
* Collaborate with business process teams (OTC, P2P, RTR, MTD, etc.) and data owners to validate business-critical data and transactions.
* Support cutover planning, mock migrations, dress rehearsals, hypercare, and post-go-live validation activities.
* Ensure global data standards, governance policies, and target-state data models are consistently adopted across deployments.
* Drive continuous improvement of migration validation processes, tools, and quality assurance methodologies.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum Bachelor’s degree is required. Computer Science or Information Systems is preferred..
* Minimum 10 years of experience in ERP transformation programs with a strong focus on Data Management, Data Migration, Data Quality, and Data Validation.
* Proven experience in at least 3 end-to-end SAP ERP/ECC to SAP S/4HANA migration programs.
* Extensive hands-on experience in migration validation and post-migration reconciliation of both Master Data and Transactional Data.
* Strong understanding of SAP data models including Customer, Vendor, Material, Finance, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing domains.
* Experience defining and executing:

+ Data Completeness Validations
+ Data Reconciliation Processes
+ Record Count Validations
+ Financial Reconciliations
+ Business Process Validations
+ Data Quality Assessments

* Experience working with large-scale datasets and enterprise migration tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate and resolve complex data issues.
* Experience collaborating with global business stakeholders, data owners, and functional teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

This full-time role will provide production support for U.S.-based clients during U.S. business hours, with responsibility for monitoring, administration, troubleshooting, maintenance, and support of HCL WebSphere Application Server and related middleware technologies.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical professional with strong production support experience, disciplined documentation habits, and the judgment to respond effectively to incidents, escalations, scheduled maintenance, and on-call needs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide managed services support for enterprise middleware environments, including IBM WebSphere Application Server, HCL Portal, IBM ACE, and related integration and security components.
* Perform daily system health checks, monitoring review, incident triage, service request fulfillment, and operational follow-up for assigned client environments.
* Deploy, update, and support enterprise applications, including artifact release management, application rollouts, and post-deployment validation.
* Troubleshoot application and middleware issues by reviewing logs, heap dumps, system alerts, configuration settings, and performance indicators.
* Apply fix packs, patches, configuration changes, and maintenance updates in accordance with approved change control processes.
* Support SSL certificate management, user access administration, authentication mechanisms, SAML/SSO-related configurations, and security-related maintenance activities.
* Create, maintain, and execute administrative scripts using Jython, wsadmin, shell scripting, or similar automation tools to improve operational efficiency.
* Prepare clear documentation for incidents, service requests, operational procedures, root cause analysis inputs, and knowledge base articles.
* Coordinate with Centroid service delivery managers, U.S.-based technical teams, and client stakeholders to resolve issues and meet service commitments.
* Participate in after-hours maintenance windows, escalation coverage, and rotating on-call support when required.

Required Skillset:
  
  

* 8+ years of experience in middleware administration, production support, or enterprise application support environments.
* Hands-on experience administering IBM WebSphere Application Server version 8.5 or later in enterprise environments.
* Experience installing, updating, deploying, and supporting enterprise applications and related middleware artifacts.
* Strong troubleshooting skills, including log analysis, heap dump review, patching support, error diagnosis, and root cause analysis.
* Working knowledge of Linux or AIX operating systems, networking fundamentals, and database integration concepts.
* Experience with middleware security administration, including SSL certificates, access roles, authentication, and secure configuration practices.
* Ability to create and maintain automation scripts using Jython, wsadmin, shell scripting, or similar tools.
* Strong verbal, written, organizational, and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to provide accurate and realistic effort estimates, commit to assigned work, and deliver accordingly.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced managed services environment and prioritize multiple incidents, service requests, maintenance activities, and client commitments.
* Ability to work productively in a team environment and participate as a positive, collaborative, and cooperative team member.
* Candidates should be flexible to cover U.S. business hours from India and support scheduled maintenance windows, incident escalations, and after-hours on-call coverage as required.

Preferred Skills:
  
  

* Experience with HCL Portal version 8.5 or later, including Web Content Management, syndication, portlet deployment, and xmlaccess.
* Experience with IBM Application Connect Enterprise (ACE) version 12.
* Experience with IBM Security Verify Access / ISVA / ISAM version 10 or later, including Federation, SAML, and SSO.
* Experience supporting managed services, production operations, or client-facing support environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based incident, problem, change, and service request management processes.
* Experience working with ticketing, monitoring, and knowledge management tools in a structured support environment.
* Experience supporting multiple client environments or shared services operations.
* Immediate joiners preferred.

Work Schedule and Location
  
  
This position is based in Hyderabad, India and supports U.S. business hours for Centroid’s North American managed services clients. Exact working hours may vary based on client coverage needs, maintenance windows, and escalation requirements.
  
  
Success Profile
  
  
A successful candidate will be reliable, detail-oriented, client-service focused, and comfortable supporting multiple production environments in a structured managed services model. They should combine hands-on technical execution with clear communication, disciplined documentation, and consistent follow-through.

The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region
  
  
What you have
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Platform Frameworks & Engineering Standards
  
  

* Design and build reusable data platform frameworks for ingestion, transformation, validation, and consumption.
* Establish standardized patterns for data pipelines, APIs, and visualization layers across SAMDA.
* Define best practices for schema evolution, versioning, error handling, and observability.
* Influence platform roadmap through hands on engineering leadership.

Design & Build Advanced Data Pipelines
  
  

* Architect and implement complex, cloud native ETL/ELT pipelines supporting investment and analytical data.
* Build reliable workflows using GCS, Dataproc, Cloud Dataflow, Composer (Airflow), and Pub/Sub.
* Implement scalable transformations and curated layers in Snowflake and cloud data warehouses.

Investment Data Domain Focus
  
  
This role has deep ownership within the Investment Data domain, including but not limited to:
  
  

* Holdings, positions, transactions, cash flows, and security master data
* Portfolio, account, and instrument hierarchies
* Performance, risk, exposure, and attribution datasets
* Reference data, taxonomies, and domain models that support downstream analytics and reporting

The engineer is responsible for designing domain driven data models and operational data stores that accurately represent investment concepts and scale across multiple SAM products and platforms.
  
  
Investment Data Modeling & Domain Engineering
  
  

* Design enterprise grade investment data models using Kimball, relational, and domain driven design principles.
* Create operational and analytical data stores from the ground up, including taxonomies and canonical models.
* Ensure models support regulatory, performance, and investment analytics use cases.

Data APIs & Service Layer
  
  

* Design and implement Data APIs using Python (FastAPI / Flask) to expose curated investment datasets.
* Build scalable, secure RESTful services for analytical and operational consumers.
* Apply governance, access control, and data protection standards aligned with regulated environments.

Python Dashboards & Data Visualization
  
  

* Develop Python based dashboards and UI applications using Streamlit, Dash, Panel, or similar frameworks.
* Create interactive visualizations using Plotly, Matplotlib, and Seaborn to support investment insights.
* Translate complex investment data into intuitive, self service analytical experiences.

Advanced Cloud & Application Engineering
  
  

* Build data and application services using Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and Cloud SQL.
* Apply distributed processing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Beam, and Flink.
* Package and deploy data services, APIs, and UI components using Docker.

DevOps, CI/CD & Automation
  
  

* Lead CI/CD design for pipelines, APIs, and visualization apps using Git, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Jenkins, and GitHub Actions.
* Implement automated testing, deployment, and release management patterns.
* Drive infrastructure automation using Terraform or Google Cloud Deployment Manager.

Data Quality, Reliability & Observability
  
  

* Define and implement data quality frameworks, reconciliation checks, and monitoring standards.
* Proactively identify and resolve complex data, platform, and application issues.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Act as a senior technical leader and mentor for data engineers across SAMDA.
* Lead design reviews and influence cross team engineering decisions.
* Communicate complex platform and investment data concepts to technical and business stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  

* 6–8 years of experience building cloud based data platforms and enterprise data solutions.
* Strong experience in the Investment or Asset Management data domain.
* Hands on expertise with Snowflake and GCP services (GCS, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Composer, Cloud SQL).
* Advanced proficiency in Python for data engineering, API development, and visualization.
* Proven experience building REST APIs using Python frameworks (FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent).
* Experience with Python visualization and UI frameworks (Streamlit, Dash, Panel, or similar).
* Strong background with distributed processing frameworks (Spark, Beam, or Flink).
* Expertise in CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and infrastructure as code (Terraform or GCP Deployment Manager).

**Tools & Technologies**

* Cloud: GCP (GCS, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, Composer)
* Data Warehouses: Snowflake, BigQuery
* Processing: Spark, Beam, Flink
* APIs: Python (FastAPI, Flask)
* Visualization/UI: Streamlit, Dash, Panel, Plotly, Matplotlib, Seaborn
* DevOps: Git, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker
* IaC: Terraform, Google Cloud Deployment Manager.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience designing platform level frameworks adopted by multiple engineering teams.
  
  

* Deep understanding of regulated data environments, governance, lineage, and auditability.
* Strong grasp of modern data architecture and self service analytics patterns.
* Ability to influence platform strategy and mentor senior engineers.
* Excellent documentation and executive level communication skills.

What’s in it for you
  
  
At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.
  
  
**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**

* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more

* Annual reimbursement for health check-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day-to-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

title: Sr. Specialist, Data Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Data Engineer, you will design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines and platforms and ensure pipeline reliability, performance and governance through automation, monitoring, logging and documentation. You will partner with data scientists, analysts and business stakeholders to translate requirements into production-grade, observable pipelines and datasets. You will operate within a matrix environment, participating in project planning, delivery and cross-team collaboration.
  
  
**What Will You Do In This Role**

* Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines to extract data from various sources and populate a data lake and data warehouse.
* Work closely with data scientists, analysts, and business teams to understand data requirements and deliver solutions aligned with business goals.
* Build and maintain platforms that support data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration across various data sources, both internal and external.
* Use data orchestration, logging, and monitoring tools to build resilient pipelines.
* Automate data flows and pipeline monitoring to ensure scalability, performance, and resilience of the platform.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues related to the data integration platform, ensuring uptime and reliability.
* Maintain thorough documentation for integration processes, configurations, and code to ensure easy onboarding for new team members and future scalability.
* Develop pipelines to ingest data into cloud data warehouses.
* Create and deliver standard reports in accordance with stakeholder needs.
* Work within a matrix organizational structure, reporting to both the functional manager and the project manager.
* Participate in project planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring alignment with both functional and project goals.

**What Should You Have**
**Primary**
(Python, SQL, PySpark, AWS, Apache Spark, Databricks, cloud object storage, ci/cd, ETL, data modelling)
  
  

* Bachelors’ degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
* 7-11 years of experience in developing data pipelines & data infrastructure, ideally within a drug development or life sciences context.
* Strong SQL skills and solid programming experience in Python (including PySpark)
* Practical experience with AWS S3 and core AWS console concepts (IAM, regions, basic cloud architecture)
* Hands-on experience with Apache Spark (concepts and usage) and Databricks (platform use, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog)
* Experience with cloud object storage (e.g., Amazon S3) and cloud data warehouses or lakehouses (e.g., Redshift, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Delta Lake)
* Familiarity with data modeling, ETL/ELT patterns, and data transformation best practices
* Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and data quality checks for operational pipelines
* Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and pipelines for data deployments, experience with Git-based tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps)
* Proven ability to work collaboratively with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders
* Good interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written)
* Product and customer-centric approach and innovative thinking

**Secondary skills (nice to have)**
(Experience with AI Assisted code development, GitHub Copilot, people management, and team lead experience)
  
  

* Prior experience in a global or matrixed organization
* Exposure to observability and data quality platforms (Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, Deequ)
* Knowledge of orchestration and scheduling tools (Airflow, Prefect, Azure Data Factory)

**Who We Are**
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What We Look For**
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

Amazon Web Services (AWS), Apache Spark, CI/CD, Cloud Software, Databricks Platform, Data ETL, Data Modeling, PySpark, Python (Programming Language), Structured Query Language (SQL)
  
  
**Preferred Skills**
GitHub, Microsoft Copilot, People Management

title: Manager-Data & ML Engg
description:
**Job Summary**
Manager Data and ML Engineering role focusing on designing building and optimizing scalable data platforms and machine learning solutions using Java advanced JavaScript and advanced Java in a hybrid work model enabling secure high quality data products that power analytics and intelligent applications for global business stakeholders in a collaborative and inclusive environment
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Architect robust data pipelines and platforms that ingest transform and serve large scale datasets using Java and advanced Java to support analytics and machine learning initiatives for diverse business functions
* Design modular and reusable services and APIs using Java and advanced JavaScript that reliably expose data and ML capabilities to internal applications and external partner systems
* Develop production ready machine learning workflows that manage data preparation feature engineering model training and model deployment while ensuring traceability and reproducibility across environments
* Implement strong data quality controls including validation checks anomaly detection data reconciliation and monitoring to maintain trusted datasets for decision making
* Optimize performance of batch and real time data processing jobs by tuning code parallelization strategies and resource usage to achieve reliable throughput and cost efficiency
* Collaborate closely with data scientists analysts and product teams to translate analytical requirements into scalable engineering solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes
* Establish coding standards review practices and version control workflows that improve reliability maintainability and security of data and ML engineering codebases
* Coordinate with cloud infrastructure and security teams to ensure data pipelines storage layers and ML services adhere to enterprise standards and regulatory expectations
* Create detailed technical documentation for data models transformation logic interface contracts and operational procedures that help teams onboard and maintain solutions efficiently
* Enable robust observability by implementing logging metrics and alerting for data and ML pipelines so that issues are detected early and resolved with minimal business disruption
* Mentor junior engineers by reviewing work sharing best practices and guiding them through complex engineering problems to raise overall team capability and delivery quality
* Drive continuous improvement by evaluating new tools frameworks and design patterns in the Java and JavaScript ecosystem and proposing adoption where they add clear value
* Align engineering activities with organizational sustainability and social impact goals by prioritizing efficient architectures that reduce resource consumption and support ethical use of data

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate ten to fourteen years of hands on experience in designing and implementing data intensive applications using Java and advanced Java with strong focus on scalability and reliability
* Exhibit advanced proficiency with modern JavaScript frameworks and tooling to build or integrate front end or service layer components that interact with data and ML platforms
* Apply solid understanding of machine learning lifecycle including feature pipelines model training evaluation and deployment using industry standard tools and libraries
* Show proven experience working in hybrid work models by effectively collaborating across onsite and remote teams using structured communication and documentation practices
* Display strong knowledge of relational and nonrelational databases data warehousing concepts and streaming platforms to support both batch and real time data solutions
* Utilize deep expertise in software engineering fundamentals including algorithms data structures design patterns testing strategies and secure coding practices
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders while gathering feedback and aligning solutions to business objectives

title: Senior IT Supervisor
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
We are looking for an experienced Senior Supervisor – Data Science / AI Development to join the GOSC Hyperautomation Team. The role involves hands-on development of Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Intelligent Automation solutions, along with team leadership and project delivery responsibilities.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise in Python, SQL, Snowflake, Databricks, ML/DL, NLP, GenAI, LLMs, RAG, and Agentic AI, with the ability to lead developers, manage priorities, and deliver scalable AI solutions. In addition to hands-on technical development, this role will be responsible for team supervision, technical mentoring, resource planning, project coordination, and ensuring timely delivery of AI and Hyperautomation initiatives.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership position, combining approximately 60% technical development, 25% project management/delivery coordination and 15% team leadership.
  
  
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
  
  

* Provides leadership for those involved in the development, design, and optimization of one or more information technology and systems functions supporting company business processes and technical information systems platforms.
* Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, analysis, selection and modification of enterprise systems, application software, installation of network hardware/software and database management.
* Provides direction for the effort required to protect the company's data, tools, and information systems.
* Ensures infrastructure architecture standards maximize efficiency and support platform compatibility.
* Usually requires subject matter knowledge of user group for practical application of system characteristics.
* Coordinates delivery of services to user groups and ensures IT service is uninterrupted.
* Selects, develops, and evaluates personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function.
* Functional Skills: Knowledge of Information Systems, Execution of Business Processes, Operational Planning, IT Service or Process Management, Metric and SLA Monitoring.
* Management Skills: Management of People & Resources, Critical Thinking, Project Management, Collaboration and Productivity Software, Effective Communication.

**PEOPLE MANAGEMENT FUNCTIONAL CAREER STREAM:**
Management and supervisory professionals with one or more employees who are focused on tactical, operational and some strategic activities within a specified area. Levels within the management career stream typically have six or more direct reports. The majority of time is spent overseeing their area of responsibility, managing performance, developing talent, engagement and inclusion, communicating business and operational developments, planning, prioritizing and / or directing the responsibilities of direct reports. Goal achievement is typically accomplished through performance of direct and / or indirect reports. A key responsibility of roles in this career stream is managing people. which includes: accountability for mentoring, developing and coaching staff on meeting/exceeding performance expectations and defined objectives, providing leadership to staff ensuring the prioritization of strategic and department level initiatives to include defining performance goals and targets, conducting performance reviews, and staff 1:1s to guide performance management and employee development efforts and manage toward departmental goals.
  
  
**DIFFERENTIATING FACTORS**
**Autonomy:**
Supervises team members or subordinate supervisors, providing tactical and / or technical leadership. May perform ongoing operational tasks. Receives assignments in task-oriented terms and delivers results according to established procedures.
  
  
**Organizational Impact:**
Plans and establishes goals and objectives for a team, typically within (1) department. Decisions impact project or department schedules, customer satisfaction levels, or allocation of time or material resources. Typically does not have budget or P&L accountability, but may manage day-to-day elements of the budget (eg, overtime for staff).
  
  
**Innovation and Complexity:**
Makes improvements to processes, systems or products. Problems and issues faced are difficult and may require understanding of broader set of issues, including multiple job areas or specialties.
  
  
**Communication and Influence:**
Communicates with internal and external customers and vendors, across various levels of the organization. Shares and exchanges relevant information to reach solutions, and gaining cooperation of other parties.
  
  
**Leadership and Talent Management:**
May be a second level supervisor of employees in the Support career stream, such as production, distribution or technicians. May be a first level supervisor of employees in the Associate or Intermediate level in the Specialist career stream. May be a first level supervisor of employees at level IV and V in the Support career stream. Leads, directs and reviews the work of team members in order to accomplish operational plans and results. Provides primary input to hiring, firing, promotion, performance and rewards decisions for direct reports.
