title: Customer MDM Architect
description:
Job title: Customer MDM Architect
  
  
Location: Hyderabad
  
  
Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.
  
  
Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
  
  
At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
  
  
B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
  
  
About the job:
  
  
We are looking for a Customer MDM Architect with Delivery Management responsibilities to lead the design, implementation, and evolution of our global Customer Master Data platform.
  
  
This role combines deep hands-on expertise in Informatica IDMC Customer 360 SaaS solution with strong delivery leadership capabilities. You will be accountable for both:
  
  
Designing and governing the Customer MDM architecture
  
  
Orchestrating end-to-end agile delivery across countries, upstream/downstream systems, and stakeholders
  
  
Our technology stack is based on Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (Customer 360 SaaS) + Snowflake/Databricks.
  
  
You will play a critical role in ensuring high-quality, governed, scalable, and business-aligned customer master data capabilities that enable global growth and enhanced customer experience.
  
  
Main responsibilities:
  
  

* MDM Architecture & Solution Design

Own and evolve the end-to-end Customer MDM architecture landscape
  
  
Design and implement scalable solutions using Informatica Customer 360 SaaS
  
  
Drive the design and implementation of the MDM solution (Informatica SaaS MDM) which will be a key enabler for our global expansion and for enhancing customer experience.
  
  
Define and help maintain Customer data models, hierarchies, and reference data structures
  
  
Design ingress and egress mechanisms (batch and API-based integrations)
  
  
Define match & merge logic, survivorship rules, and performance optimization strategies
  
  
Ensure seamless integration between MDM, Snowflake/Databricks, and upstream/downstream systems
  
  
Define data synchronization and replication mechanisms
  
  
Maintain master data dictionaries and metadata documentation
  
  
Define testing strategies (batch & real-time ingestion)
  
  
Monitor performance, scalability, and platform optimization
  
  
Analyze existing data structures, systems, and processes to identify data management gaps and opportunities for improvement
  
  
Maintain and document the end-to-end MDM landscape architecture, including integrations, data flows, and system dependencies (high-level + detail view)
  
  

* Data Governance & Data Quality

Ensure alignment with enterprise Data Governance policies
  
  
Define and implement data quality rules and monitoring frameworks with the help of the DG team
  
  
Perform data profiling, cleansing, deduplication, and standardization
  
  
Implement and optimize match & merge strategies
  
  
Define KPIs to monitor data quality and governance effectiveness
  
  
Collaborate with Data Stewards, Domain Owners, and Governance bodies
  
  
Produce data quality dashboards and trend reports
  
  
Implement security and access controls for sensitive master data
  
  

* Delivery Management & Agile Orchestration

Act as the Delivery Lead for the Customer MDM area:
  
  
Drive stakeholder alignment and business adoption across countries
  
  
Own scope, risks, dependencies, and issue management
  
  
Help orchestrate agile ceremonies and sprint execution
  
  
Prioritize and manage backlog (user stories, L3 tickets, enhancements)
  
  
Help ensure structured coordination between:
  
  
Upstream systems
  
  
Downstream applications
  
  
Data owners Business teams
  
  
Countries
  
  
Coordinate development, testing, cutover, hypercare, and knowledge transfer
  
  
Manage integration dependencies and cross-system impacts
  
  
Ensure structured documentation, RACI definition, and status reporting
  
  
Support onboarding, training materials, and change management activities
  
  
Resolve blockers and ensure smooth sprint execution
  
  

* Stakeholder Leadership & Communication

Conduct workshops and stakeholder interviews to gather and analyze business and technical requirements for Informatica Customer 360 SaaS implementations
  
  
Translate business needs into scalable MDM solutions
  
  
Support business case evolution and roadmap definition
  
  
Provide technical mentorship to team members
  
  
Communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs clearly
  
  
Drive adoption through structured communication and enablement
  
  
About you:
  
  
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field
  
  
10+ years of hands-on experience in Master Data Management with 3+ years of Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS solution, with at least +3 years managing teams and delivering successful MDM implementations
  
  
Proven experience with:
  
  
Informatica IDMC Customer 360 SaaS / Multidomain MDM
  
  
Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS)
  
  
Informatica Reference 360 (strong plus)
  
  
Strong experience integrating MDM with Snowflake/Databricks or enterprise DWH platforms
  
  
Deep understanding of:
  
  
Customer data models
  
  
Match & Merge strategies
  
  
Data governance frameworks
  
  
Data quality methodologies
  
  
Experience in defining and implementing MDM solution architectures
  
  
Strong knowledge of batch and API-based integration patterns
  
  
Experience with Power BI or equivalent reporting tools (plus)
  
  
Experience leading agile delivery in complex, multi-country environments
  
  
Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills
  
  
Certifications in Informatica MDM (Developer / Administrator) are a plus.
  
  
Key Competencies
  
  
Strategic thinker with hands-on technical depth
  
  
Strong ownership and accountability mindset
  
  
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  
  
Ability to balance governance rigor with business agility
  
  
Strong communication skills across business and technical audiences
  
  
Comfortable operating in complex, multi-system environments
  
  
Structured, organized, and delivery-oriented
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
High-quality, trusted Customer Master Data adopted across countries
  
  
Stable and scalable MDM architecture aligned with enterprise data strategy
  
  
On-time and predictable delivery execution
  
  
Clear governance, documented architecture, and measurable data quality improvements
  
  
Strong collaboration between IT, business, governance, and operationsWhy us?
  
  
At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
  
  
We Are Challengers.
  
  
We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things:
  
  
All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
  
  
Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
  
  
Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
  
  
Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
  
  
Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

title: Database Administrator, Specialist
description:
Provides advanced level database administrator (DBA) services for production, test, and development databases across multiple platforms. Provides senior level physical database design, creation, and maintenance services.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
At Vanguard, technology is integral to helping our clients reach their personal goals. We depend on IT 24/7 to run our investors’ assets. That puts your expertise in Technology Operations at the heart of our business.
  
  
As a Database Administrator, you will be joining the Database Operations team supporting Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server and AWS database technologies (Postgres, DynamoDB, etc.). You will work with application developers, fellow DBA’s, and IT leadership to improve the efficiency, resiliency, production stability, automation, and reliability of Vanguard’s database infrastructure. The Database Operations team is primarily responsible for ensuring the operational availability/recoverability of all enterprise database platforms. The team is also responsible for administration/maintenance, upgrades/patching, performance tuning and completion of database requests from internal customers.
  
  
**Responsibilites**

* Ensure backup, recovery, security, availability, maintenance and performance of enterprise database technology.
* Create and maintain backup and recovery jobs.
* Resolve database issues and help to determine root cause.
* Perform administration, installation, upgrade, configuration, and patch management of all enterprise database technology.
* Perform on-call support on a rotational basis.
* Provide support during normal business hours to developer requests on a rotational basis.
* Recommend database technology features/functions to application developers.
* Assist with testing and evaluating IT vendor products.
* Review application designs for compliance with production acceptance requirements.
* Provide key technical input and expertise in large scale projects.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 5 years of experience as a database administrator, data modeler, business systems analyst, developer, or in a similar role involving enterprise data platforms
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Minimum of five years database administrator experience with Oracle, SQL Server or AWS (Postgres, DynamoDB)
* Certification in Oracle, SQL Server, or AWS, preferred but not required.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, including interviewing and presentation skills.
* Strong relationship management, analytical, problem solving and organizational skills.
* Broad knowledge of the financial services industry.
* Ability to effectively multi-task.
* Flexibility, strong decision-making skills and effective time management skills.
* Proven ability to work with attention to detail under tight time constraints.

**Working knowledge and experience with some or all of the following**
:
  
  
  

* MS Windows and/or Linux (Redhat) based operating systems
* Virtualization – VMware
* Distributed Computing Hardware Technologies
* Network Technologies – SDN, DNS, Ethernet Fabrics, Firewalls, Load Balancers, WAN, WiFi, etc.
* Directory Services – Active Directory/LDAP
* Backup and disaster recovery testing
* Job scheduling (Control-M)
* ITIL (Incident/Problem Management, CMDB) (ServiceNow)

**The ideal candidate should have working knowledge of:**

* DBA best practices and concepts: database backup & recovery, database performance tuning, database monitoring, and maintenance.
* Hands on experience of Oracle, SQL Server and AWS (Postgres, DynamoDB) database technologies.
* Troubleshoot complex systems to identify bottlenecks (SQL, IO, hardware, query related, etc.) and resolve database related issues.
* Ability to support multiple releases (e.g., Oracle 12c/18c/19c, Microsoft SQL Server 2016/2019, etc).
* Designing databases and data modeling concepts.
* Automation and scripting skills; PowerShell, Shell Scripting, PL/SQL, T-SQL, etc.
* Working knowledge of Cloud Providers & Solutions / AWS preferred.
* Great communication and documentation skills that leads to internal problem resolutions documents, lessons learned, how to, and knowledge transfer.
* Strong skills with troubleshooting, researching and resolving blocking/deadlocking, connectivity issues, data corruption, security issues etc.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: AI Tech lead
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The AI Tech Lead serves as a key technical resource for the ZenAI platform and a critical escalation point for complex platform, integration, and engineering issues. The role requires deep platform expertise and is responsible for feature evaluation, advanced technical consulting, and development of the internal tools on which the team depends. The AI Tech Lead ensures that solutions deployed on ZenAI are optimized for performance, cost efficiency, and model selection; advises power users and technical audiences on advanced platform capabilities; and serves as the technical liaison to vendor engineering and support teams. This role will initially operate as an individual contributor and is expected to evolve into a people-leadership position with one to three direct reports as the team grows. The role also provides complementary coverage across time zones in partnership with the global AI Capabilities & Governance team.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Master Data and Capacity Model Ownership:**
  Own the capacity model and related planning master data in SAP IBP. Use the master data dashboard to identify gaps or inaccuracies in production run rates, changeover constraints, material lead times, resource calendars and other planning parameters. Coordinate corrections with the relevant supply planners and master data stewards responsible for maintaining the source data in ECC/S/4HANA.

* **Constraint Identification and Alert Generation:**
  Run SAP IBP heuristics and planning algorithms to identify constraints across the supply network. Generate system alerts for capacity bottlenecks, material shortages, safety stock violations, and demand-supply imbalances.

* **Scenario Building:**
  Build comparable scenarios with consistent assumptions that enable the Supply Planers in both the Mid-Term and Short-Term to evaluate alternatives. Ensure scenarios are structured, repeatable, and documented so that leadership can compare options on a level playing field.

* **Resolution Modelling:**
  Execute resolution modelling in SAP S4 ePPDS and SAP IBP to test proposed solutions before they are committed. Validate feasibility of allocation changes, schedule adjustments, and capacity rebalancing options.

* **Digital Twin Development:**
  Drive digital twin development as organizational maturity evolves. Progress the modelling capability through maturity stages: heuristic-based planning, optimizer-driven planning, and ultimately AI/Joule-enabled autonomous planning.

* **Data and Parameter Stewardship:**
  Serve as the owner of planning parameters, ensuring that safety stock targets, lot sizes, planning horizons, and aggregation rules are correctly configured and regularly reviewed for accuracy. Ensure issues identified through modelling or business plan validation are escalated and corrected at source where required.

**RESOURCES MANAGED**

***Financial Accountability***

None.

***Supervision***

Initially an individual contributor role. Expected to supervise one to three ZICC-based direct reports (AI Tech Analysts) over time as the team grows.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

The following education and experience qualifications are required or preferred:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field required; advanced degree preferred
* 8+ years of professional experience in technical roles such as software engineering, platform engineering, or solution architecture
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with API integrations, enterprise system connections, and automation platforms
* Demonstrated expertise with AI platforms and technologies, including agentic and generative AI
* Experience evaluating, testing, and rolling out new platform features in an enterprise environment
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across multiple systems
* Experience building internal tooling, dashboards, and automation solutions
* Prior people leadership or team lead experience preferred
* Experience in the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or regulated industry preferred

**TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

The following technical skills are required or preferred:

* Deep expertise with enterprise AI platforms and technologies, including agents, workflows, skills, integrations, and agentic AI; experience with Langdock, OpenAI, or similar platforms preferred.
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) services and MCP gateways; experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and event-driven architectures
* Strong proficiency in Python and scripting languages for automation and tooling
* Experience with Databricks preferred
* Proficiency with database technologies (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and reporting frameworks
* Understanding of FinOps principles, token/cost tracking, and spend optimization
* Experience with AI-assisted coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, GPT Codex, or similar)
* Experience with Flask, Posit/RStudio, or similar application development frameworks
* Proficiency with collaboration tools (Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

**PHYSICAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

Primarily office-based at the Zoetis India Capability Center (ZICC) in Hyderabad, India. Occasional travel (0-10%). description:
**What you will do on your journey with WebBeds.**

As an SAP Consultant Lead / SAP ABAP Developer Lead, you will join the growing global SAP team at WebBeds and play a key role in our SAP S/4HANA and RISE with SAP transformation journey.

**\***
These roles are based in Hyderabad and can also be considered in Bangalore, Pune, Chennai or Noida. We are building an internal SAP capability to drive innovation, reduce reliance on external partners and establish long-term ownership of our business processes and SAP solutions.'

We are recruiting across multiple functional and technical domains, with opportunities for SAP R2R, O2C, P2P & FP&A, together with an SAP ABAP Developer Lead.

Each successful candidate will lead delivery and solution ownership within their area of expertise. Functional Leads will collaborate with Finance, Procurement, Commercial and Operations teams to translate business requirements into scalable SAP solutions, while the SAP ABAP Developer Lead will partner with Functional Leads, Global Process Owners and technical teams to deliver Clean Core-aligned developments, integrations, analytics and automation.

All roles will contribute to process standardisation, innovation, compliance, operational excellence and measurable business value.

**In this role you will:**

**Key responsibilities**

* **End-to-end delivery:**
  lead delivery within your assigned functional domain or ABAP technical specialism, from requirements and solution design through testing, deployment, go-live, hypercare and operational handover.
* **Stakeholder partnership:**
  partner with business stakeholders, Global Process Owners, SAP teams, integration teams and delivery partners to define scalable future-state solutions.

* **Design, testing and deployment:**
  lead or support workshops, fit-gap analysis, solution design, documentation, SIT, UAT, end-to-end testing, data migration, cutover and production readiness.
* **Automation and governance:**
  drive automation, process standardisation, continuous improvement, controls, compliance and governance.
* **Innovation:**
  identify opportunities to apply SAP Signavio, SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP BTP, SAP Build, Datasphere, SAC, Cloud ALM and LeanIX where relevant to your role (nice to have).
* **Specialist leadership:**
  provide leadership within your specialist area through design assurance, quality oversight, knowledge transfer and effective collaboration with internal and external teams.
* **Record-to-Report (R2R) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end R2R processes within SAP S/4HANA, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Tax, Financial Close, Statutory and Management Reporting, Profitability Analysis (CO-PA), Bank Reconciliations and Finance Controls, and partner with O2C and P2P process owners to support an integrated Finance operating model across the WebBeds SAP landscape.
* **Order-to-Cash (O2C) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end O2C processes within SAP S/4HANA, including Customer Master Data, Sales Order Management, Pricing, Billing and Invoicing, Accounts Receivable, Credit Management, Collections, Dispute Management, Cash Application, Revenue Management and customer experience optimisation, and lead the design, configuration, standardisation and continuous improvement of SAP SD and FSCM capabilities to strengthen revenue assurance, working capital, collections effectiveness and operational efficiency.

  own end-to-end P2P processes within SAP S/4HANA, including Supplier Master Data and Onboarding, Sourcing and Contracts, Requisitions, Purchase Orders, Goods and Service Receipts, Invoice Verification, Supplier Reconciliations, Payment Integration, Spend Visibility, Procurement Compliance, Supplier Performance, and SAP MM procurement and inventory management.
* **Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own planning and performance management processes, including budgeting, rolling forecasts, scenario modelling, cost and profit centre planning, allocations, profitability analysis, business performance analysis, management reporting, dashboards, planning standardisation, SAC Planning, Datasphere and decision-support insights.
* **SAP ABAP Developer Lead:**
  own the technical design and delivery of SAP ABAP and BTP solutions across R2R, O2C, P2P & FP&A, translating functional requirements into scalable RICEFW objects, custom transactions, reports, interfaces, forms, workflows, CDS-based data models, APIs, integrations, Fiori services and intelligent automation solutions aligned with Clean Core principles.

**The skills we would love to see in your suitcase!**

* Proven experience in at least one of the functional domains (R2R, O2C, P2P, FP&A) or in SAP ABAP development, with relevant professional experience, technical expertise and business process knowledge.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, strong hands-on SAP ABAP experience in S/4HANA, including ABAP Objects, Data Dictionary, ALV, Smart Forms or Adobe Forms, enhancements, BAdIs, user exits and performance optimisation.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, experience developing across SAP FI, CO, MM and SD business processes, with the ability to understand functional specifications and intended business outcomes.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, integration experience using IDocs, BAPIs, APIs, SAP Integration Suite or equivalent SAP integration technologies.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, advanced experience with ABAP CDS Views, including data models, analytical queries and consumption views supporting Fiori, Datasphere, SAC and Finance reporting.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, experience with RAP, OData services, APIs, SAP Gateway, Fiori/UI5 extensibility and SAP BTP or side-by-side extension patterns.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, exposure to SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP Build, AI-assisted development, workflow automation or agentic automation is strongly preferred (nice to have).
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, the ability to lead technical design, code reviews, development standards, documentation, testing, transport governance, defect resolution and developer mentoring.
* Please apply for the role that best aligns with your experience and state clearly in your application which role or domain best matches your background, demonstrating relevant depth in that area.
* Applications will be assessed against the requirements of the selected functional domain or SAP ABAP technical role.

title: Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
For a single team delivering components of distributed systems. Translates goals into a 1–2 quarter execution plan, sets coding, testing, and scalability practices, and provides hands-on oversight of performance tuning and load/perf testing. Guides the team in building fault-tolerant, in-service-upgradable components (redundancy, replication, failover) and in applying resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts). Ensures robust observability (tests, alarms, dashboards, telemetry) and operational readiness via reviewed runbooks and standard procedures. Manages delivery of scoped features and correctness testing (including fault-injection/brownouts), and directs implementation of data replication/synchronization to maintain integrity and availability. Leads team incident response and root-cause efforts, enforces no-customer-downtime practices, and drives use of automation/IaC for troubleshooting. Oversees team security implementation (encryption, access controls), tracks remediation plans, verifies compliance documentation, and coaches adherence to change-management plans for safe patching, updates, and rollbacks.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**System Design & Architecture – System Scalability:**

* Provides oversight to the team on the development of components of distributed systems, including the use of distributed state management tools.
* Monitors and enables optimization of code and/or systems for large-scale data processing.
* Guides team to implement scalability requirements for assigned components.
* Coaches team to leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
* Ensures team accurately implements and executes performance and load testing.

**System Design & Architecture – System Reliability Design:**

* Provides guidance to the team in building fault-tolerant systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by leading the implementation of redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
* Guides the design of components to effectively handle service disruptions.
* Coaches team on various approaches to handle network unreliability, including retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts.

**System Design & Architecture – System Reliability Performance:**

* Guides team to implement testing and alarming configurations for detecting and addressing issues/failures.
* Ensures team effectively supports recovery efforts by reviewing and aligning on runbooks and operational procedures.
* Coaches team on building and customizing dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

**System Design & Architecture – Correctness / Availability:**

* Manages the implementation and design of functional requirements and testing for features within an existing system.
* Coaches team on implementing test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
* Guides the implementation of data replication and synchronization techniques within the team to maintain data integrity and availability.

**Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:**

* Leads team efforts in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in system components to support ongoing operation.
* Ensures teams are following protocols for preventing interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
* Manages team in effectively implementing automation scripts and tooling when troubleshooting operational issues.
* Creates schedules and manages operational support rotations.

**Compliance & Security:**

* Manages team implementation of robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, overseeing encryption techniques and access controls.
* Manages execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, ensuring continuous improvement of security measures.
* Reviews documentation and ensures cloud infrastructure compliance with industry standards and regulations.

**Automation & Change Management:**

* Leads the maintenance of automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
* Coaches team on change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Creates and owns the execution plan for the team’s work and multiple projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines and budgets (when applicable) to ensure projects are completed on time and in adherence with requirements.
* Delegates work across the team and helps them prioritize their work.
* Identifies resource needs and adapts plans based on changing priorities and business needs.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Strengthens collaborative partnerships across teams to align on expectations and shared objectives.
* Guides team members to build relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure effective collaboration.
* Practices active listening and asks insightful questions to promote an inclusive culture.

**Problem Solving:**

* Leads team to identify and address moderately complex operational and/or technical issues in accordance with standard practices, providing guidance as appropriate.

  **100% Work from Office**
  )
* **Experience Required:**
  12–15 Years
* **Job Type:**
  Full-Time / Permanent
* **Client Context:**
  US-Based Fortune 200 Energy & Utilities Enterprise
* **Travel Requirement:**
  Active
  **US Business Visa (B1/B2)**
  required for potential immediate travel deployment

**About Us: The Prodigy DNA**

**At Prodigy Systems and Services**
, we are an
**AI-Native, extensive-engineering-focused enterprise**
that believes software engineering is an elite craft. For over
**14 years**
, we have maintained a deeply trusted, bulletproof foothold with our primary US Fortune 200 client. Today, we have a powerhouse family of
**70 elite engineers**
actively scaling and supporting their infrastructure.

We are a tight-knit family of professionals built on a core pillar of deep mutual respect. Our strengths are anchored in
**Customer First, Integrity, Transparency, and Innovation**
. We are working hungry, driven to make a true difference in society and the world through hyper-velocity technological progress.

When you join Prodigy, you will experience:

* **Warm, brilliant colleagues**
  who push you to be your best engineering self.
* **A humble management team**
  that is fiercely committed to doing the right thing.
* **An environment of radical documentation:**
  We live by a strict operational doctrine:
  **"Over-communication is a mandatory requirement."**
  We heavily utilize Microsoft Teams, Emails, and written technical specs.
  **If it is not in writing, it never happened.**

**Role Description & Intent**

**We are looking for a powerhouse, battle-tested Senior Consultant / Principal Engineer (IC)**
who can single-handedly pull the engineering weight of an entire team. This is a high-throttle street—the work is highly demanding, intensely fast-paced, yet deeply rewarding.

This is strictly a
**production-code-producing role**
. You will not be limited to high-level whiteboard architecture; you must actively write, optimize, compile, and ship the code you design. You will be responsible for tearing down a legacy enterprise stack and rebuilding it from scratch using state-of-the-art Generative AI acceleration.

**Core Responsibilities & Technical Expectations**

* **Production Code Execution:**
  Massively produce clean, scalable, production-grade code leveraging
  **Microsoft .NET Core (C#)**
  and advanced
  **SQL Server**
  engineering.
* **AI-Autonomous Engineering:**
  Operate as an AI-augmented developer. You must natively orchestrate autonomous AI software agents (like
  **Devin**
  ) and advanced tools (
  **ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf**
  ) within sandboxed environments to multiply development speed.
* **Spec-Driven Development (SDD):**
  Write software exclusively against rigorous, unambiguous technical specifications. Code is only written once the spec is perfect.
* **Architectural Rigor:**
  Strictly apply
  **SOLID principles**
  and decoupled design patterns to ensure the new stack is easily maintainable.
* **High-Scale Engineering:**
  Design, implement, and maintain systems built to handle
  **0.5 Million+ active customers**
  and scale smoothly through
  **5 Million+ transactions daily**
  with bulletproof stability.
* **Hybrid Infrastructure Management:**
  Engineer code optimized to run seamlessly within a primary
  **On-Premises Data Center**
  while managing low-latency replication and automated failover pipelines to
  **AWS Disaster Recovery (DR)**
  .
* **Observability & Instrumentation:**
  Build world-class distributed log instrumentation and tracing setups to ensure zero blind spots across the On-Prem/AWS boundary.
* **Cost-Sensitive Engineering:**
  Demonstrate a relentless focus on minimizing cloud operational spend, compute overhead, and execution costs per transaction.

**Core Skills & Competencies**

* **Primary Stack:**
  Microsoft .NET C#, .NET Core, Advanced SQL Server (Query optimization, locking, indexing structures).
* **AI Engineering:**
  Cognition Devin orchestration, ChatGPT prompt engineering, Cursor, Windsurf.
* **Methodologies:**
  Spec-Driven Development (SDD), SOLID Principles, Test-Driven Development (TDD).
* **Infrastructure:**
  Hybrid Data Centers, AWS Core Services (EC2, S3, RDS, DR automation).
* **Observability:**
  Advanced Distributed Logging, Telemetry, and APM Instrumentation.
* **Industry Knowledge:**
  Prior experience in the
  **Texas Energy & Utilities sector**
  (ERCOT, smart grids, or deregulated market clearing) is a massive plus.

**Rigorous 4-Round Interview Evaluation Process**

1. **Round 1: Elite Core Engineering & Architecture Deep-Dive**

* *Focus:*
  Severe testing of .NET/C# memory allocations, asynchronous programming models, multi-threading, and SQL Server transactional plan internals.

1. **Round 2: The AI-Augmented Hyper-Velocity Coding Challenge**

* *Focus:*
  A live, 60-minute, hands-on programming test. Candidates must leverage Generative AI tools (Devin/Cursor paradigms) to modernize a complex legacy code block into fully instrumented, spec-driven code.

1. **Round 3: Scale, Hybrid Infra & Cost-Sensitive Systems Design**

* *Focus:*
  Whiteboard scenario cracking. Designing for 5M daily transactions, maintaining sync across On-Prem and AWS DR, and proving compute-cost efficiency.

1. **Round 4: High-Throttle Executive & Cultural Fit**

* *Focus:*
  Evaluation of written and verbal communication fluency, mental stamina under high pressure.

**Cloud, platform and engineering practices**

Â· Implement CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, monitoring and infrastructure automation using DataOps and DevSecOps practices.
  
  
Â· Define observability, alerting and performance-tuning approaches across databases, pipelines, warehouses and cloud services.

Â·

in Data engineering and enterprise platforms.

Analytics, AI and intelligent data solutions.

description:

* Provide thought leadership and technical guidance to junior staff and business partners.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data flows, reports, and system integrations.
* Stay current with the latest developments in SAP analytics technologies and best practices.
* Collaborate with functional teams for issue resolution
* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Work effectively within structured, process-driven environments

Deloitte’s SAP Service Line is among the world’s largest, with 8,000 global practitioners and over 1,700 SAP implementation projects completed. More than half of our consultants have 10+ years of experience, and Deloitte has been an SAP Global Partner — Services since 1989. We offer a full range of SAP services, from business case development to deployment, supported by nine solution centers and proprietary accelerators that enhance project delivery. Our CMMI Level 5 and SAS 70-certified practice covers S4 Hana, CRM, NetWeaver, BO, Development, BASIS & Infrastructure, and serves all functional areas and industry sectors.

**Must have Skills:**

* 4 - 6 Years of hands-on experience with SAP Analytics with BW4HANA + SAC (1-2 years) or SAP Datasphere (1 year) + SAC (1-2 years) across implementation projects or SAP Embedded Analytics (3-4 Years) + SAC (1-2 Years)

+ Understanding and implementing ingestion to Data platform via extractors, CDS, SDI, SLT, ODP frameworks
+ Modelling in BW / Datasphere with different artifacts like ADSO, Composite Providers, Open ODS Views, Hybrid modelling, dataflows, transformational flows, graphical views, calculations views, script scripts/procedures, analytical models, etc.
+ Extractor enhancements with User Exits, Customer Exits, BADI
+ Design, develop, and optimize CDS Views to support embedded analytics in SAP S/4HANA
+ Integrate CDS views with Fiori Elements, Analytical List Pages (ALP), KPIs, and Smart Business Cockpits
+ Techniques for performance optimization of Views, query performance and data load processes.
+ Proficiency in SAC Story creation, data modeling, and SAC scripting (for analytical applications). Strong understanding of SAC features such as Smart Insights, Smart Predict, and R Visualization. Familiarity with connecting and consuming data from SAP BW/Datasphere/S/4HANA and embedding SAC in Fiori or other business apps.
+ Building complex data models—hierarchies, calculated measures, input tasks, and advanced data wrangling abilities and advanced use of widgets, linked analysis, bookmarks, and input controls

* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.

title: Senior Technical Engineer – LabVantage Master Data
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**About Lilly**
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
**About The Technology Organization**
At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Hyderabad builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.
  
  
**About The Business Function**
From molecule to market, Global Manufacturing plays an important role in every step along a product’s lifecycle. Most of our customers never see the scientific and technical resources behind our medicines. But customers experience, every day, the performance of our high-quality products and global supply network.
  
  
Global Manufacturing comprises a core group of functions that drives the production and supply of high-quality products: Engineering; Manufacturing Information & Control Systems (Technology@Lilly); Quality & Labs, Technology Services/Manufacturing Science; Global Health, Safety and Environment; and Supply Chain.
  
  
**Role: Senior Technical Engineer – LabVantage Master Data**
The Senior Technical Engineer will be leading designing, building, and automating analytical test methods and associated data and specifications within LabVantage LIMS, and for developing or coordinating the development of instrument drivers and integrations that enable direct data capture into LIMS from laboratory instruments.
  
  
This role combines domain expertise in laboratory processes and analytical methods with technical leadership in LIMS MD configuration & Custom development. The incumbent will play a key role in advancing the organization’s digital laboratory ecosystem, driving data integrity, automation, and compliance in GxP systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**What**
**you’ll**
**be doing:**
**LabVantage MD Development & Build**

* Develop the configuration, creation, and lifecycle management of analytical test methods in LabVantage LIMS (i.e. All interconnected MDs to support entire workflow for test method to work as per expectations).
* Implement test templates, specifications, and parameter lists ensuring standardization and scalability across products and sites.
* Define and maintain Test method metadata structures for automation (units, limits, calculations, result entry templates).
* Custom Script development for data transfer or verifications
* Implement Test method versioning, review, and approval workflows in accordance with organisational data governance and validation policies.
* Partner with functional SMEs to ensure test methods adhering with GxP, ALCOA+, and analytical method validation principles.
* Build test scenarios/ documents and Test method templates

**Technical Maintenance and Master Data Support**

* Triage, analyze and resolve issues through root cause analysis, harnessing both business and technical knowledge to minimize downtime.
* Driver L3 Engineering with global data team, site team and ensuring timely completion
* Develop and maintain scripts, business rules, and LabVantage SDK components to automate data processing and workflow activities.
* Enable service improvement through fixes of incidences
* Support and analyze instrument integrations (e.g.,Lab Application - Empower, Chromeleon, SmartLab, Darwin, Complex instruments) and maintain data exchange with ERP, ELN, QMS, EM and analytics systems.

**Automation & Digital Integration**

* Develop automation frameworks to reduce manual effort in test method setup and instrument data handling.
* Support initiatives for automated test method build from structured templates or upstream systems (ERP/PLM).
* Collaborate with analytics teams to make instrument and method data analytics-ready for dashboards and trending.

**Governance, Validation & Documentation**

* Support for versioned MD, and auditable as part of GxP compliance and following regulatory and Lilly IT quality standards (CSV-Computer System Validation).
* Create design documents, configuration specifications and technical SOPs for test method.
* Support QA in CSV, change control, and periodic review activities.
* Active participation in audits and ensure all automation components meet 21 CFR Part 11 and Annex 11 requirements.
* Prepare and maintain design specifications, configuration documentation, and validation test scripts for IQ/OQ/PQ activities along with installation procedures
* Support change control, release management, ensuring compliance and stability in a multi-environment setup.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Strong technical SME for LabVantage test method management
* Collaboration with site-level LabVantage data stewards to lead test methods management
* Partner with global digital, quality, and IT SMEs to define and implement standards for method and instrument onboarding.
* Enable process improvement through automation, template standardization, and adoption of new technologies

**How You Will Succeed**

* Reduced manual effort and faster development of new test methods.
* Improved data flow between LabVantage and analytical instruments in secured environment
* Compliance with global lab data governance and validation standards.
* Enablement of analytics-ready, high-quality laboratory data.

**What You Should Bring**

* Strong analytical and critical thinking.
* Technical proficiency in LIMS MD development, management and delievrables
* Understanding of analytical lab workflows and instruments.
* Excellent documentation and verbal communication
* Ability to work across global teams (IT, Quality, Lab Operations).
* Strategic outlook to connect lab automation initiatives with enterprise digital goals.

**Basic Qualifications And Experience Requirement**

* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Computer Science/ Instrumentation /Chemical Engineering / Analytical Chemistry, or related field.
* 8+ years of experience in laboratory informatics, preferably in the pharma, biotech, or chemicals industry.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience configuring and deploying LabVantage LIMS Master Data (i.e. test methods, specifications, calculations, and workflows).
* Experience integrating LabVantage with chromatography and analytical instrument systems (Empower, Chromeleon, Microplate readers, etc.).
* Strong knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and data integrity principles (ALCOA+).
* Familiarity with ETL/middleware tools and system validation (CSV/SDLC) practices.
* Exposure to data analytics or digital lab transformation projects is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with JIRA, ALM, Git and ServiceNow (SNOW) for requirement tracking, defect management, and change control activities in regulated environments.

*At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients. It is how we work. We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work. This is not just a policy. It is who we are.*

dotSolved drives digital transformations for enterprises by defining, automating, and optimizing complex business processes for the digital era and engineering modern, data & analytic driven, applications that deliver intended business value. **Job Description**
**Position: Senior NetSuite Technical Consultant**
Location: Hyderabad - Remote
  
  
Engagement Type: Full Time
  
  
Shift Timing: 3.00AM - 12.00PM PST (US Pacific Time)
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy advanced customizations using SuiteScript (1.0 & 2.x), SuiteTalk (SOAP/REST web services), SuiteFlow, and the SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF).
* Architecture & Design: Own the technical architecture for complex customizations, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and adherence to NetSuite best practices and governance limits.
* Integration Development: Build and maintain inbound/outbound integrations between NetSuite and third-party systems (Salesforce, billing platforms, EDI, middleware such as Boomi, MuleSoft, or Workato).
* Code Review & Governance: Establish and enforce coding standards, conduct peer code reviews, and manage version control/deployment pipelines (SDF, CI/CD) across Sandbox and Production environments.
* Performance Optimization: Diagnose and resolve script governance issues, performance bottlenecks, and data integrity problems in high-volume transactional environments.
* Solution Design: Translate functional requirements and solution design documents (SDDs) into technical specifications and working code.
* Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and code review support to junior developers on the team.
* AI & Automation: Evaluate and implement NetSuite's native AI capabilities (SuiteSense, etc.) and scripted automation to streamline financial and operational workflows.

**Key Qualifications**

* Experience: 7+ years of hands-on NetSuite development experience, including full-lifecycle implementations and ongoing managed services/support.
* Technical Proficiency: Expert-level SuiteScript 2.x (and working knowledge of 1.0), strong JavaScript fundamentals, and deep understanding of the NetSuite data model, record types, and SuiteCloud platform architecture.
* APIs & Integration: Extensive experience with SuiteTalk (REST/SOAP), RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts, and third-party API integration patterns.
* Customization Tools: Advanced experience with SuiteBuilder, SuiteFlow, Workflow Action scripts, Custom Records, and Saved Searches/SuiteQL.
* Environment Management: Proven experience managing code deployments and configuration across Sandbox, Release Preview, and Production environments using SDF and bundle management.
* Consultative Mindset: Ability to advise on "out of the box" vs. custom development trade-offs, articulating ROI and long-term maintenance costs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Documentation: Strong ability to produce technical design documents, unit test plans, and deployment runbooks.
* Language: Fluency in English (written and verbal) required.
* Certification: NetSuite Certified SuiteCloud Developer strongly preferred; NetSuite Certified ERP Consultant a plus.

**Must-Have Experience**

* Deep understanding of ERP core business processes: Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), and financial management (GL, AR, AP)
* Advanced SuiteScript 2.x development (Map/Reduce, Scheduled, User Event, Client, RESTlet scripts)
* Strong SQL/SuiteQL skills for complex reporting and data extraction
* Experience with NetSuite governance, script deployment records, and error handling/logging frameworks
* Experience building and troubleshooting inbound/outbound integrations at scale
* Experience with Advanced Financials (OneWorld, intercompany elimination, financial reporting)
* Experience with Advanced Revenue Recognition
* Experience with tax engines (OneSource or NetSuite native taxation)
* Experience supporting both greenfield implementations and post-go-live managed service

title: Associate Director , Data Stewardship
description:
**Job Description**
**R419321 Associate. Director , Data Stewardship**
**The Opportunity**
Join a global biopharma company with a 130-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
  
  
Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
  
  
This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days per week in the office and 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within a commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.The Associate Director, Technical Product Owner – Automation & Material Master Stewardship is a high-impact, hybrid leadership role. It requires a rare blend of deep Material Master Data domain expertise and advanced technical product management capabilities.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of supply chain operations, enterprise IT, and digital innovation, this individual will own the technical roadmap for our core data creation and maintenance platforms (specifically Syniti / DSP and its complex integrations into SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA).
  
  
The role's mission is twofold
  
  

* Material Master Domain Leadership & Tool Ownership Act as the technical and operational authority for the global Material Master data model in our stewardship tools. You will ensure these systems operate with high reliability, comply with rigid data standards, and evolve through structured releases to support complex supply chain and manufacturing activities.
* Process Automation & Workflow Re-engineering Partner with Global Data Steward Leads, Quality, and IT teams to systematically transition stewardship activities from manual, high-touch execution to intelligent, streamlined, and automated workflows.

As a senior technical leader within the Hyderabad Tech Center, you will leverage local technical talent while maintaining global alignment to drive operational excellence, GxP compliance, and modern automation practices (including generative AI and workflow orchestration).
  
  
**What Will You Do in This Ro**
le
  
  

* Material Master Data Domain Governance & Platform Ownership

Govern the Material Master Data Model Serve as the technical custodian for the Material Master data structure within our stewardship tools, ensuring a deep understanding of master data dependencies, taxonomy, and downstream impacts on manufacturing and logistics.
  
  
Own the Tooling Ecosystem Act as the Technical Product Owner for data creation, change management, and validation tooling (such as Syniti/DSP and associated middleware connecting into SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA).
  
  
Align Business Logic with Tech Translate complex Material Master requirements (e.g., global vs. local views, Plant/Storage Location parameters, Bill of Materials (BOM) configurations, and regulatory metadata) into precise technical specifications and tool rules.
  
  
Backlog & Release Management Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, feature prioritization, and release roadmaps in close coordination with IT delivery engineers, architecture teams, and global business stewards.
  
  

* Process Re-Engineering, Simplification & Automation

End-to-End Material Workflow Optimization Deep-dive into existing material stewardship processes (such as first-time material code creation, changes, and plant extensions) to eliminate manual bottlenecks, redundant pre-checks, and handoff delays.
  
  
Intelligent Automation Delivery Design, evaluate, and implement automation solutions across the material lifecycle, utilizing business rule engines, automated validation scripts, API integrations, and low-code orchestration platforms.
  
  
AI & GenAI Integration Spearhead the practical adoption of generative AI (e.g., Gemini) and machine learning capabilities to assist data stewards in automated data validation, material request interpretation, anomaly detection, and auto-generated documentation.
  
  
Industry Best Practices Benchmark external master data management (MDM) and supply chain automation frameworks to keep our operating model forward-looking and scalable.
  
  

* Quality, GxP Compliance & Data Integrity

Quality & Validation Partnership Partner closely with Quality Assurance, Computer Systems Validation (CSV), and Regulatory teams to ensure all tooling enhancements, automation bots, and scripts meet strict GxP and audit standards.
  
  
Automated Data Quality & Controls Build automated, GxP-compliant data governance pre-checks, validation rules, and mandatory approval workflows directly into the tooling UI to enforce data integrity at the moment of entry.
  
  
Audit Readiness & Traceability Ensure full lifecycle traceability, change control documentation, and audit trail reliability for all automated and system-assisted data operations.
  
  

* Global Partnership, Location Synergy & Team Upskilling

Bridge IT and Stewardship Operations Serve as the primary technical liaison in Hyderabad, connecting local IT/software product development with global data stewardship leaders and supply chain operations.
  
  
Drive Change & Adoption Partner with Global Data Leads and operational managers to design rollout plans, training materials, and change-management programs for new automated ways of working.
  
  
Technical Mentorship Foster an automation-first culture across the Hyderabad stewardship hub, coaching team members on digital tools, prompt engineering, and automated testing practices.
  
  
What Should You Have
  
  

* Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Data Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

**Experience**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in Master Data Management (MDM), Technical Product Ownership, Business Systems Analysis, or Enterprise Data Solutions.
* Strong functional background in SAP Material Master (MM) operations, with a clear understanding of supply chain, procurement, and manufacturing data flows.
* Substantial experience operating in a regulated enterprise environment (pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare, or medical devices preferred).
* Proven track record of owning enterprise tooling releases and delivering measurable automation or process simplification projects.

**Primary Skills (Must-Have)**

* Deep Material Master Data Expertise Comprehensive, practical knowledge of the SAP Material Master data structure, fields, views (Basic, Sales, Purchasing, MRP, Plant/Storage, Costing), and how data setups impact downstream physical supply chain execution.
* Tool Ownership & MDM Platforms Hands-on technical experience with master data creation and governance platforms, preferably Syniti (DSP) or comparable enterprise MDM/governance suites.
* SAP Master Data Architecture Solid technical and functional knowledge of SAP master data processes (SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA), specifically Material Master and its integration with manufacturing, procurement, and supply chain modules.
* Process Automation & Digitization Demonstrated success identifying, designing, and rolling out workflow automation, rule engines, RPA, or automated data validation pipelines.
* Modern AI & GenAI Fluency Practical experience leveraging Generative AI (e.g., Gemini) and digital productivity tools to accelerate data operations, validation logic, and process documentation.
* Agile Product Ownership Expertise in Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies, writing technical user stories, managing sprint roadmaps, and running User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* GxP & Regulated Environment Compliance Strong understanding of GxP standards, Computer Systems Validation (CSV), data integrity requirements, and regulated change control procedures.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge complex business requirements with technical IT engineering across global time zones.

**Who We Are**
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What We Look For**
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

title: Advanced Software Engr
description:
**Job Description**
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Function: Engineering / Platform & Data Infrastructure**
**About The Role**
We are looking for a highly experienced Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) with deep expertise in MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch to own and support mission-critical database platforms serving enterprise SaaS applications. This role is not suitable for candidates with only development or basic DBA experience. The ideal candidate has extensive hands-on experience designing, operating, troubleshooting, and optimizing large-scale production environments containing millions of records, supporting 24x7 high-availability systems with strict uptime SLAs. The engineer will independently diagnose complex database failures, perform failovers, optimize performance under load, ensure business continuity, influence technical direction, and mentor junior engineers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Database Design & Architecture**

* Architect and implement scalable, high-availability MongoDB solutions including replica sets, sharded clusters, Atlas deployments, and disaster recovery architectures.
* Design, implement, and manage MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch environments across development, staging, and production.
* Define schema design standards, sharding strategies, indexing approaches, data lifecycle management, and capacity planning.

**Production Reliability & Operations**

* Own 24x7 production database operations with accountability for uptime, reliability, and SLA compliance.
* Diagnose and resolve complex database incidents, execute failovers, recovery activities, root-cause analysis, and business continuity procedures.
* Lead rolling upgrades, patching, migrations, and maintenance with minimal or zero downtime.

**Performance & Optimization**

* Analyze query patterns, design optimal indexes, tune aggregation pipelines, and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Monitor performance metrics and drive continuous improvements using profiler, explain plans, Atlas tools, and observability platforms.
* Optimize high-volume databases containing millions of records and heavy workloads.

**Security & Reliability**

* Implement RBAC, TLS/SSL, encryption, LDAP integration, auditing, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies.
* Ensure enterprise-grade database security, resilience, and operational governance.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Define database best practices, review data models, and provide technical leadership.
* Mentor junior engineers and collaborate with development, platform, SRE, and DevOps teams.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of database engineering, DBRE, DBA, or related experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on MongoDB production support experience.
* Deep expertise in replica sets, sharding, Atlas, replication, failover, query tuning, and aggregation framework.
* Strong PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch administration and performance tuning experience.
* Experience managing databases supporting enterprise SaaS applications and millions of records.
* Cloud experience on Azure , AWS, or GCP and strong Linux administration skills.
* Programming experience in .NET, Java, Python, JavaScript/Node.js, or similar technologies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MongoDB Certified DBA or Developer certification.
* MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, time-series collections, Ops Manager, or Cloud Manager experience.
* Experience with Kafka, Spark, Redis, Elasticsearch, Azure Cosmos DB, and database migrations.
* Background in SaaS, telemetry, IoT, or large-scale enterprise data platforms.

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

description:

What’s in it for you
  
  
At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.

title: Data Infrastructure & Integration Engineer
description:
**About SkySpecs:**

At SkySpecs, our mission is to simplify renewable asset management so less can do more for the planet. SkySpecs is making this possible by automating wind farm operations and maintenance with advanced robotics paired with our custom-built asset performance management software, Horizon.

SkySpecs launched the world’s first completely autonomous blade inspection product in 2016 with a custom-designed drone system. Since then, SkySpecs has inspected over 90% of US wind turbines and expanded globally, becoming the world leader in understanding turbine blade health. Identifying issues with turbine blades is only the first step. In 2019, SkySpecs launched Horizon, a platform for SkySpecs to offer a multi-layered solution for customers that includes: data collection, wind turbine blade engineering expertise, and a place for all stakeholders to collaborate to manage and analyze massive amounts of data, spot trends, and create plans for high-cost repair campaigns. In 2021, SkySpecs acquired two companies specializing in wind turbine drivetrain monitoring and financial management, further expanding our asset management portfolio. Ultimately, this will help reduce the cost and risk of operations for the industry.

**What will you be getting into?**

Join a collaborative team of Product Managers, Software Engineers, Leads, and Developers dedicated to building and managing a state-of-the-art analytics and decision-support platform tailored for the renewable energy sector. Together, we deploy, operate, and maintain the essential software and infrastructure that seamlessly connects diverse customer data systems with Horizon CMS, our advanced drivetrain analytics platform.

**As a Data Infrastructure & Integration Engineer, you will:**

* Configure, deploy, and maintain tools and infrastructure that enable the flow of CMS,
* SCADA, and other data into our cloud-based platforms, including Horizon CMS
* Detect, track, and resolve data connectivity issues across the entire fleet of customer data system integrations
* Help maintain underlying AWS infrastructure for data connectivity
* Collaborate with service delivery teams to ensure high-quality, reliable data is available for their analysis and reporting
* Respond to data connectivity trouble tickets and work the issues to completion
* Work with the connectivity team to create and improve processes needed for increased scalability and efficiency

**Requirements of the job:**

* 3+ years of work experience in a technical engineering, operations, or analyst role
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Strong Unix/Linux command line skills
* A basic understanding of data protocols, networking concepts, and IT security practices
* Fluency in English and excellent communication skills
* Ability to work outside normal business hours, when needed, to support the global team

**Bonus Point:**

* Experience in the wind power industry, especially drivetrain condition monitoring
* Proficiency with AWS tools and services like S3, EC2, VPC, and CloudWatch
* Experience with data analysis tools and scripting, e.g., using Python, SQL
* Capability and willingness to use AI tools, such as advanced LLMs, to increase productivity
* Degree in Engineering, or an applicable technical degree from an accredited university

**Perks of the Job:**

* Time Off: Generous leave policy—among the best in the industry.
* Global Team: Work with teammates across 5 countries and diverse backgrounds.
* Impact: Help build the backbone of clean energy digital infrastructure.

title: Oracle Database Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Company / Team**
Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The candidate should also possess scripting and automation capabilities, exposure to cloud infrastructure, particularly Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and the ability to support complex production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oracle Applications & Database Administration: Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, clone and refresh Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Oracle Database environments, including database upgrades to 19c and support for multi-node application architectures.
* Fusion Middleware & WebLogic Administration: Install, configure, manage, patch and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic Server, SOA, OBIEE and Fusion Middleware environments, including standalone and clustered deployments, JDBC Data Sources, JMS configurations, SSL and application deployments using WLST and administration utilities.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Maintain highly available Oracle environments across multiple data centers using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases, clustering, load balancing, switchover/failover procedures and disaster recovery synchronization mechanisms.
* Infrastructure & Production Support: Coordinate infrastructure, database, middleware and application changes; manage planned downtime; resolve critical production incidents; and ensure service restoration within defined SLAs in 24×7 environments.
* Performance Optimization & Capacity Management: Monitor system health, analyze performance bottlenecks, perform capacity assessments and implement proactive improvements to enhance application availability, scalability and reliability.
* Automation & Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain Python and shell scripts to automate administrative activities, streamline deployments, minimize manual interventions, reduce recurring incidents and standardize operational processes.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Migration: Provision, administer and support Oracle environments on cloud platforms, particularly OCI, and contribute to on-premises-to-cloud migration, infrastructure modernization and operational integration initiatives.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work closely with infrastructure, database, application and customer teams to diagnose complex technical issues, implement preventive measures, maintain operational documentation and support mission-critical business services.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* Minimum 5–6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Oracle Applications DBA, Database Administration and/or Fusion Middleware administration.
* BE/B.Tech, MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong expertise in at least one domain—Oracle Apps DBA or Oracle Fusion Middleware/WebLogic—with good working knowledge of the other.
* Hands-on experience administering Oracle Applications 11i/R12, including cloning, patching, refreshes, upgrades and multi-node environments.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle WebLogic Server and Fusion Middleware installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, patching and clustered architecture.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database administration, Oracle Database 19c, RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases and high-availability/disaster-recovery concepts.
