title: System Administrator
description:
Winsupply is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented IT Systems & Security Administrator (L2) with 2 to 4 years of experience to support our hybrid enterprise infrastructure and frontline security operations. In this role, you will safeguard core digital assets across multi-regional environments—monitoring endpoint and web application security events, deploying critical system patches, and responding to operational incidents. Alongside security monitoring, you will play a key role in maintaining system uptime, verifying data backups, and supporting database and network health. This is an excellent opportunity for a technical professional looking to expand their expertise across both enterprise systems administration and frontline SecOps within a collaborative global team.

In this role, you will be the operational backbone of our technical operations, ensuring high availability across servers, networks, and databases while executing critical backup routines and disaster recovery procedures. In addition, you will act as the frontline responder for security alerts (EDR/XDR and SIEM), vulnerability patching, and off-hours operational disruptions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1.Database Maintenance & Monitoring**

* Monitor relational database health, CPU utilization, disk space, memory utilization, connection pool limits, and blocking locks (e.g., DB2, SQL Server, MariaDB, or MongoDB).
* Track replication status, high-availability cluster health, and alert on replication lag or database service interruptions.
* Perform operational maintenance tasks including checking table bloat, space allocation, and executing standard service restart playbooks during scheduled off-hours.

**2.Backup, Disaster Recovery & Storage Management**

* Oversee and verify automated daily, weekly, and monthly backup schedules across enterprise systems, databases, and cloud/on-premise storage.
* Actively investigate backup failures, resolve storage capacity bottlenecks, and re-trigger failed backup jobs.
* Participate in scheduled Disaster Recovery (DR) drills and execute routine restoration validations to ensure Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) and Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) are strictly maintained.

**3.Network & Operating System Administration**

* Administer Windows Server and Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS) environments, including user access, OS patching, disk space management, and system services.
* Diagnose and resolve network connectivity issues, including DNS resolution failures, DHCP scopes, routing issues, and VPN tunnel drops.
* Verify firewall traffic rules, monitor reverse proxy/load balancer health checks, and manage SSL/TLS certificate renewals to prevent service outages.

**4.Endpoint & Web Application Security Monitoring**

* Monitor enterprise endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR) platforms (e.g., Palo Alto Cortex XDR, Defender for Endpoint).
* Triage high-severity alerts, including
  **WildFire Malware**
  sandbox verifications,
  **Local Analysis Malware**
  , and suspicious process executions.
* Execute frontline containment procedures, including host network isolation and account lockdowns following established security playbooks.
* Monitor Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and API gateways for abnormal traffic spikes, suspicious request patterns, and Layer 7 anomalies.

**5.Vulnerability & System Patch Management**

* Track infrastructure and endpoint vulnerabilities across Linux, Windows, and third-party software.
* Plan, test, and deploy monthly OS patches, kernel updates, and critical security hotfixes during approved off-hours maintenance windows.
* Coordinate patch rollbacks and mitigation steps if updates conflict with production databases or application dependencies.

**6.Incident Response & SIEM Monitoring**

* Serve as the primary responder for off-hours system outages, database alerts, network interruptions, and high-priority security incidents.
* Monitor enterprise SIEM queues (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel) for suspicious authentication attempts, brute-force patterns, and privilege escalation.
* Facilitate swift triage, coordinate with upstream engineering/DBA leads when needed, and lead post-incident Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reporting.

**7.Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain up-to-date Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational runbooks, and shift handover records.
* Track and report on key operational SLAs, including backup success rates, patch compliance percentages, and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR).

**Candidate Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:**
  2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in Systems Administration, Infrastructure Support, or an integrated SysAdmin / SecOps role.
* **Core Technical Competencies:**
* **OS & Networking:**
  Proficient in Linux and Windows Server administration, Active Directory, DNS, TCP/IP troubleshooting, and basic firewall configurations.
* **Database & Backups:**
  Hands-on experience checking database services and locks, combined with practical exposure to enterprise backup solutions (e.g., Veeam, Commvault, AWS Backup, native DB dumps).
* **Security Tools:**
  Practical familiarity with EDR/XDR consoles (Palo Alto Cortex XDR preferred) and SIEM alert monitoring.
* **Scripting (Advantageous):**
  Working knowledge of Bash, PowerShell, or Python to automate basic health checks and log reviews.
* **Work Style:**
  Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset under incident conditions.
* **Flexibility:**
  Willingness to work in rotational shifts and participate in scheduled off-hours/weekend on-call rotations.

**Qualifications/Experience**

* Associate or Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Network+, or (ISC)² SSCP are preferred.
* Familiarity with web application security concepts and common vulnerability scanners (e.g., Nessus, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).
* Basic scripting skills (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for automation and log processing are a plus.
* Experience operating within a SIEM or Security Operations Center (SOC) environment is advantageous.

title: Data Engineering SMTS/LMTS
description:
**Description**
About Salesforce
  
  
We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good– you’ve come to the right place.
  
  
**Department Overview**
The Revenue Analytics team builds the data platforms, intelligent products, modern application capabilities, and AI-enabled automation that power enterprise decision-making. We combine deep engineering expertise with business context to deliver trusted, scalable systems that support both human and agent-driven workflows.
  
  
Our team partners with business and technology leaders to solve complex challenges through modern data architecture, governed data products, integrated app services, and agentic systems. We emphasize production reliability, measurable business value, and responsible automation—not experimentation without operational accountability.
  
  
**Role Description: Hands On Data Lead & Systems Integrator**
We are seeking a
**Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS)**
to serve as a primary technical execution lead across our core data platform and its application integration interfaces.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. While operating within the overarching platform architecture established by Principal Engineers, you will own the delivery of high-impact data engineering projects, build resilient pipelines, and ensure data products seamlessly plug into downstream applications, web tools, and agentic workflows. You will bring deep expertise in core data engineering (Python, Snowflake, dbt, SQL) complemented by solid working knowledge of the app development ecosystem (Node.js, APIs, microservices) to bridge data platforms with full-stack systems. You will lead project-level execution, mentor senior engineers, and translate complex requirements into production-ready software.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Data Engineering Project Leadership & Execution: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of end-to-end data pipelines for batch and event-driven workloads. Own project-level technical delivery, write high-performance production code, and guide team members to deliver scalable data products on schedule.
* Data Platform & Product Design: Define patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and storage using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. Establish standards for data contracts, semantic consistency, lineage, and reusable data assets to support both business analytics and AI applications.
* App Ecosystem & Integration Layering: Design and maintain lightweight API integration components, Node.js services, and middleware that expose data platform capabilities to full-stack applications, web dashboards, and external enterprise platforms (Salesforce, AWS).
* Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration: Implement enterprise-controlled agentic capabilities and AI-enabled workflows. Integrate autonomous agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into application endpoints and data pipelines, ensuring structured outputs, context retrieval, and clear human-agent handoffs.
* Verification & Production Reliability: Establish testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, performance tuning, and operational observability across both data pipelines and app integration services. Define and enforce SLOs/SLAs for pipeline availability, data freshness, and API endpoint performance.
* Cross-Team Leadership & Quality Standards: Conduct code and design reviews. Mentor Senior and Associate Engineers, championing engineering standards for clean code, automated testing, and documentation across both data and application interfaces.

**Technical Profile**

* Core Data Engineering Foundations:
* Deep expertise in Python and advanced SQL, with a strong background in operating production data platforms.
* Extensive experience with data stack technologies: dbt, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, and Snowflake (including query optimization, performance tuning, cost management, and complex troubleshooting).
* Command of distributed systems, dimensional/domain-oriented data modeling, batch/streaming patterns, and Data Mesh / data-as-a-product concepts.
* Application Ecosystem & Integration Knowledge:
* Practical experience with Node.js and TypeScript / JavaScript for building lightweight backend services, microservices, or integration layers.
* Hands-on knowledge of designing and consuming REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and event queues (Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS).
* Understanding of web app integration patterns, API gateways, and enterprise authentication protocols (OAuth2, SSO).
* AI & Agentic Engineering:
* Practical experience building or integrating AI-enabled workflows using frameworks like LangGraph or LangChain.
* Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, structured outputs, context engineering, vector stores, and retrieval mechanisms.
* Effective use of AI-native developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) with rigorous review and testing of generated code.
* Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure:
* Hands-on experience operating on cloud platforms, preferably AWS.

* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.

* Performance monitoring & tuning, Problem analysis & resolution, and other activities required to maintain system integrity SAP administration on UNIX & Windows
* System /System copy
* ABAP + Java-dual stack
* Add-on and Support Pack application and troubleshooting
* Kernel Upgrade
* Client copies and export-import
* TMS administration and configuration and troubleshooting Transport errors
* SAP system monitoring and thorough analysis of issues
* SAP parameter change, operation mode setup, Logon group setup
* SAP Role based Authorization knowledge - Role creation and modification
* Spool administration and troubleshooting spool/printer issues
* OSS Note application
* Experience in Single -Sign On, Web Dispatcher
* Experience in working SAP on public cloud and private cloud.
* Experience in working with cloud service providers like AWS, Azure and GCP.
* SAP Solution Manager experience with basic and advanced configuration.
* Hands-on experience with SAP user provisioning, authorization troubleshooting, and role assignments.
* Basic knowledge of OS/DB migration processes.
* Familiarity with Web Dispatcher, Gateway, and SAP integration components.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Should have 4 to 7 years of experience in SAP Basis domain.
* Solid hands-on experience in SAP system administration, including installation, configuration, upgrades, and performance optimization.
* Should understand SAP architecture, transport management, kernel updates, and system refresh processes.
* Proficient in administering SAP HANA (monitoring, tuning, backup/recoveries, basic troubleshooting).
* Experience supporting landscapes like S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, PO/PI, Fiori, Solution Manager, etc.
* Strong SAP BTP knowledge, including key services, integration patterns, and administration fundamentals.
* Strong working experience with RISE with SAP environments and operational activities.
* Strong documentation skills for system delivery, ensuring clear, structured, and audit‑ready technical documentation.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with clients and stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Solution Manager features such as CHARM, EWA, and monitoring.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Practical experience managing SAP workloads on Azure or AWS (VMs, storage classes, networking, monitoring).
* Exposure to SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) for monitoring, change control, and operations.
* Exposure to SAP Data Archiving with OpenText

**Certifications:**

* SAP Technology Associate certifications (SAP Basis or HANA).
* SAP Cloud Certifications (RISE, BTP, HANA Cloud, etc.).
* Cloud certification (AWS, Azure and GCP).
* Exposure to enterprise transformation tools such as Signavio and LeanIX for process modeling, architecture governance, and landscape documentation.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**

**How to Apply:**

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

**SAP Datasphere Consultant with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) reporting skills**

* Design and develop data models in SAP Datasphere using spaces, tables, views, associations, transformations, and business entities.
* Build analytical and relational models to support reporting and analytics requirements.
* Integrate data from SAP and non-SAP source systems such as SAP BW, BW/4HANA, S/4HANA, HANA, ECC, flat files, and cloud sources.
* Create data flows, replication flows, remote tables, and views as per business requirements.
* Develop SAC stories, dashboards, and analytical reports using SAP Datasphere models as source.
* Build calculated measures, restricted measures, filters, input controls, charts, tables, and drill-down reports in SAC.
* Work with business users to understand reporting requirements and convert them into technical solutions.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, performance tuning, and issue resolution.
* Manage security, access control, spaces, roles, and authorizations in SAP Datasphere and SAC.
* Support testing, UAT, deployment, documentation, and production support activities.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in SAP Datasphere modeling and development.
* Good understanding of SAP Analytics Cloud reporting and dashboard development.
* Experience in creating SAC stories, KPIs, charts, tables, filters, and drill-down reports.
* Knowledge of data modeling concepts, including fact/dimension modeling, star schema, and semantic modeling.
* Experience with data integration from SAP BW/BW4HANA, S/4HANA, HANA, ECC, or other enterprise systems.
* Good knowledge of SQL, calculated columns, joins, unions, aggregations, and data transformations.
* Understanding of remote tables, data flows, replication flows, and data provisioning concepts.
* Ability to troubleshoot data issues, model performance issues, and reporting defects.
* Good understanding of security and authorization concepts in Datasphere and SAC.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work with business and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with SAP BW, BW/4HANA, HANA modeling, or SAP BDC.
* Knowledge of SAC live and import connections.
* Exposure to planning scenarios in SAC is an added advantage.
* Experience with SAP Cloud Connector, DP Agent, or integration setup is preferred.
* Basic understanding of ABAP CDS Views or S/4HANA embedded analytics will be helpful.
* Experience in migration or modernization from BW/HANA to Datasphere will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of overall SAP Analytics / BI experience.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Datasphere.
* 2+ years of experience in SAC reporting / dashboard development.

Good to Have

**Key Responsibilities**

Establish and maintain base MIDs and regional variant MIDs, manufacturer IDs, and project IDs using SAP MDG and Fiori workflows.
* Storefront & Catalogue Administration (SAP Hybris): Configure, update, and publish hardware, software, mobile devices, and bundled service plans within the internal ordering storefront. * Ticket Queue Management & Triage: Monitor, resolve, and route technical lifecycle requests and user feedback across enterprise ticketing platforms. Escalate complex backend mapping issues, data-fix exceptions, and question groups to engineering and Tier-3 backend support.

* Experience: 5–7 years in Master Data Management (MDM), Asset Lifecycle Management (ALM), supply chain operations, or enterprise IT catalogue administration.

**Job description**
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**

**Summary**
The Data Migration Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting data replication, migration, and integration solutions across cloud and on-prem environments. This role ensures secure, reliable, and high-performance data movement between heterogeneous systems, leveraging modern ETL tools, lakehouse technologies, and DevOps practices. Platform and DevOps engineering

title: SAP EWM/TMS Master Data Specialist
description:
**Recommended experience**

* 7-10 years of total SAP functional / techno-functional experience.
* At least 4-6 years focused on SAP master data, EWM, TMS, BP / CVI, IDoc / DRF replication, and production support.
* Strong preference for candidates who have supported cutover, go-live, and hypercare in a multi-system SAP landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and troubleshoot master-data replication and synchronization across SAP systems, including materials, customers, vendors, and Business Partners.
* Support SAP Business Partner, CVI, and DRF-related issues, including replication failures and master-data inconsistencies.
* Maintain and troubleshoot EWM material and warehouse master data, including warehouse/product attributes, plant extensions, UOM, serial profiles, and packaging data.
* Investigate and resolve data-quality issues related to gross/net weight, packaging, dimensions, shipping addresses, and transportation attributes.
* Troubleshoot SAP IDoc errors and integration issues affecting master-data replication and warehouse operations.
* Support shipping and transportation master data, including ship-to details, loading groups, and transportation groups.
* Perform master-data validation, reconciliation, and remediation to ensure data accuracy and consistency across systems.
* Support warehouse deployments, cutover activities, and go-live readiness for new sites and 3PL operations.
* Manage incidents, service requests, and defects using ServiceNow and JIRA, including root-cause analysis and documentation.
* Collaborate with business, functional, and technical teams to resolve recurring issues and implement preventive measures.

**Required qualifications**

* Strong experience in SAP master data processes for customer, vendor, BP, material, batch, serial, and equipment-related domains.
* Hands-on experience with SAP EWM and good working knowledge of warehouse-specific product / material setup, inbound delivery, outbound delivery, and warehouse execution processes.
* Working knowledge of SAP TMS-related master data and cross-functional dependencies with logistics and shipping processes.
* Experience with CVI, BP integration, DRF, ALE / IDoc processing, and cross-system replication troubleshooting.
* Ability to analyze master-data defects across ECC, EWM, TMS, and connected systems, including data dependencies between MM, IM, deliveries, batch, serial, and equipment flows.
* Strong understanding of MM / IM concepts, packaging data, weight / dimension data, units of measure, serial management, equipment handling, batch management, and warehouse-specific product controls.
* Experience working on production support queues with incident triage, root-cause analysis, and turnaround expectations.
* Good communication skills and the ability to work directly with business users during urgent cutover or go-live windows.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in SAP S/4 transformation or enterprise migration programs.
* Knowledge of transportation or shipping master data issues, including destination address, partner data, and downstream shipping-system dependencies.
* Experience with packaging master-data maintenance, warehouse extensions, serial-profile corrections, and unit-of-measure setup.
* Ability to write functional specifications and coordinate with ABAP, middleware, and integration teams for enhancements.

**Education requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
* Master's degree or MBA is preferred but not required.
* SAP certification in MM, EWM, S/4HANA, or related logistics / integration areas is a plus.

* Integrate Snowflake and pipeline health (job failures, data freshness, query performance) into the team's observability stack for centralized monitoring and alerting

  **AWS**

  **OCI**

**Position:**
SAP Basis Engineer

**Work Schedule:**
Monday - Friday

The SAP Basis Engineer solves technical problems while working on technology initiatives; improving structures, existing tools, systems, components, processes, and solutions. Engineers in this role ensures delivery of high quality artifacts; and adheres to Costco’s SAP best practices. As well as, interact in a highly effective manner with other team members and management; drive innovation; and influence delivery and performance. The successful candidate must have deep knowledge and hands-on experience in enterprise-wide SAP platform; and have strong architectural, leadership, and technical skills.

* Performs the administration and operation of the SAP HANA systems and associated components and 3rd party tools.
* Serves as technical support for medium to complex problem resolution. Provide technical expertise for resolving escalated system issues. Participate in crisis meetings as necessary.
* Uses subject matter expertise to support industry standard source control and source change management techniques.
* Determines appropriate escalation of issues and supports resolution by following up.
* Resolves incidents affecting the operation/availability of global systems, through troubleshooting and implementing known fixes.
* Creates conceptual and detailed technical design documents and standards.
* Enhances automation of applications, systems, and platforms; and identifies opportunities for streamlining and continuous process improvement.
* Collaborates with architects to plan, design, implement, and improve new capabilities, enhancements, solutions, and/or platforms.

* Develops team vision to drive new capabilities against a published roadmap.
* Ensures that proposed and existing systems are aligned with organizational standards, goals, and objectives.
* Formulates and directs activities that align short term goals and long term initiatives, while providing accurate and timely estimates (work breakdown schedules).
* Works with teams, management, and stakeholders to conceptualize, design, build, test, and release products.
* Tests and resolves problems; performs root cause analysis; identifies gaps; recommends solution and preventative measures; and leads team members to solution delivery plans.

* Identifies opportunities and design solutions that continuously extract value from SAP applications.
* Ensures all project artifacts and deliverables are documented, approved, and stored for re-usability, support, and audit purposes in designated project tools.
* Regular and reliable workplace attendance at your assigned location.
* Assists in other areas of the department and company as necessary.

**Experience, Skills, Education & Licenses/Certifications:**

**Required:**

* 10+ years’ deep SAP Basis experience in a large enterprise environment.
* 10+ years’ in designing, leading, and implementing medium to large scale projects.
* 10+ years’ experience in production support, including problem identification. (Root cause analysis).
* 10+ years’ experience troubleshooting and recommending technical solutions.
* SAP HANA Certification
* SAP TADM Certification
* Flexible in deep diving into project detail when necessary, while keeping the overall picture in mind.
* Team player with strong communication skills, both oral and written, including presentation skills.
* Extremely responsive with a strong sense of urgency.

**Hands-on experience working in the following applications:**

* S/4 HANA, HCM, ECC, CRM, CAR, SLT, BW, Fiori, EWM, SSO, ADS, Portals, HANA Sidecar, BODS, BOBJ, PI/PO, LaMa, Content Server, TREX

**Hands-on experience with:**

* Backup and Restore, Failover, and Disaster Recovery procedures
* evaluating, installation, configuration and deployment of SAP applications
* SAP upgrades including Support Packs and Enhancement Packs
* Hands-on experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux
* SAP Performance tuning
* Data Archiving and Table Partitioning
* HANA System Replication
* Knowledge of BTP, BDC, Cloud ALM, and Focused Run
* Technically fluent in SQL
* Ability to write Bash Shell
* Ability to adjust priorities in rapidly changing environments; work well under pressure, and work independently.

**Recommended:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or Computer Science preferred.
* Documentation and presentation skills catered to a diverse technical and business audience.
* Knowledge of Google products: Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides

Experience with the Informatica cloud platform would be ideal for this position. • Experience in integration of on-premises applications with SaaS applications
  
• Experience in integrating ERP applications such as SAP, Salesforce, etc.

• Resolving Platform environment issues and applying EBF’s, Patches and Hot Fixes.
  
• Automation of Backups, Purge, Build scripts, startups, and shutdown scripts.

title: Senior Healthcare Data Integration Analyst
description:
**Aliases:**
Senior EHR Data Implementation Analyst (Epic/Cerner), Lead, Healthcare Data Exchange and Interoperability, Senior Clinical Data Mapping and Integration Analyst, Healthcare Data Ingestion and Interoperability Engineer, Senior Clinical Informatics Analyst - Data Integration, Healthcare Implementation Consultant - Data.
  
  
**About Truveta**
Truveta is the world's first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.
  
  
Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest in the USA and has employees who live across the country. As we expand our global footprint with a new presence in Hyderabad, India, we're building a world-class team to help us scale this mission, and high-quality, well-integrated health data is at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
*This job requires daily onsite work at our headquarters in Hyderabad, India.*
**Who We Need**
Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you.
  
  
**This Opportunity**
We are seeking a Senior Healthcare Data Integration Analyst to lead and support the onboarding of member data into the Truveta platform. This role is central to ensuring high-quality, well-integrated data that meets clinical, research, and operational needs.
  
  
The ideal candidate is passionate about working with complex healthcare datasets, uncovering patterns in disparate source systems, and building scalable processes that make downstream analytics efficient and reliable. You will work closely with external member teams and internal engineering stakeholders to profile, map, validate, and automate data ingestion workflows, bringing hands-on experience with clinical applications such as Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, or Allscripts and with healthcare data standards including HL7, FHIR, and CCDA.
  
  
Working from the Truveta India Development Center, you will partner every day with engineering, product, and member teams in the United States, so regular overlap with US Pacific (West Coast) business hours is part of the role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead onboarding of data from member source systems and third-party sources into the Truveta platform.
* Partner with external technical and clinical teams to understand source data structures, workflows, and business context.
* Perform comprehensive data profiling to assess completeness, quality, conformance, and integrity.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mappings aligned to platform data models and standards.
* Define, implement, and validate business and data transformation rules.
* Design and support test automation strategies for onboarding workflows, including validation and regression testing.
* Document onboarding methodologies, transformation logic, data quality findings, and validation processes to ensure reproducibility and knowledge sharing.
* Provide clear, timely communication to stakeholders, from customer-facing discussions to deep technical design sessions.
* Continuously improve onboarding processes to increase scalability, efficiency, and reliability.

**Experience**

* Subject matter expertise in clinical applications and an understanding of how healthcare data supports clinicians, researchers, and patients.
* Strong knowledge of healthcare industry terminology and concepts.
* Hands-on experience with data profiling tools, data quality analysis, and visualization technologies.
* Deep understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, and data lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex datasets and translate business workflows into technical specifications.
* Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and external partners.
* A track record of producing comprehensive documentation of methodologies, processes, and findings that supports reproducibility and knowledge sharing.
* Self-starter with a strong ownership mindset and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

**Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or graduate degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or related analytical field.
* 6+ years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or healthcare data implementation roles.
* 3+ years of implementation experience with clinical applications such as Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, or Allscripts.
* 3+ years of experience analyzing large datasets, with strong proficiency in SQL and Python or R.
* Demonstrated experience with data profiling, source-to-target mapping, and validation testing.
* Experience supporting customer or partner engagement during technical implementations.
* Experience translating clinical workflows into informatics or analytics applications.
* Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange standards (HL7, FHIR, CCDA) and clinical ontologies (ICD, SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm, CPT, NDC).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with both customer-facing and highly technical audiences.
* Ability to collaborate across time zones in a distributed team, with regular overlap with US Pacific (West Coast) hours.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience at a health system or healthcare technology company.
* Experience with modern cloud-native platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, Databricks, or Snowflake.
* Hands-on experience with healthcare integration engines such as Mirth Connect, Rhapsody, or Cloverleaf.
* Experience delivering data implementations for US health system clients from a global delivery or offshore engineering center.

They should be proactive, adaptable, and committed to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

title: Specialist - Data Quality & Governance
description:
**Build Our Future Together**
At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Data Quality & Governance Specialist – Snowflake Data Operations to join our Data Governance team, supporting our Data Analytics Data Science organization in a hybrid work model. In this role, you will implement data quality, data catalogue, lineage, and access governance activities on the Snowflake platform while collaborating with data owners, data stewards, Analytics, Data Science, and Data Governance teams. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
  
  
**When & Where**
Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**Discover Your Role**

* Profile assigned data assets within Snowflake to assess completeness, consistency, accuracy, uniqueness, and timeliness, producing reports that support data quality rule prioritization.
* Implement and monitor data quality rules using Snowflake Data Metric Functions, Dynamic Data Masking, and Row Access Policies, following agreed rule logic and coding standards.
* Generate exception reports and dashboards, track remediation activities, and raise issues or ambiguities to senior team members when needed.
* Maintain the Data Quality Rule Register, ensuring rule logic, thresholds, rationale, and change history documentation remain accurate and current.
* Manage catalogue entries within Horizon and support the documentation and validation of data lineage, classifications, ownership assignments, and provenance records.
* Support Snowflake role-based access control (RBAC) governance activities, access certification reviews, audit evidence preparation, and Data Marketplace catalogue management.
* You actively develop expertise in Snowflake governance and data quality practices while seeking feedback and continuous learning opportunities.
* You collaborate effectively with technical and business partners, sharing progress, supporting team objectives, and helping maintain high governance standards.

**This Role Requires**

* Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of relevant experience; advanced degree may be considered with 2+ years of relevant experience.
* Foundational hands-on experience with Snowflake, or a strong demonstrated ability and eagerness to rapidly develop Snowflake expertise, including SQL, Data Metric Functions, and Row Access Policies.
* Proficiency in SQL with the ability to write and review data quality rule logic and perform basic data transformations.
* Understanding of data quality concepts, including profiling techniques and quality dimensions such as completeness, consistency, accuracy, uniqueness, and timeliness.
* Knowledge of data governance principles, including metadata management, data ownership, and data catalogue practices.
* Ability to create clear, structured documentation, reports, dashboards, and governance records for technical and business audiences.
* Familiarity with Snowflake Horizon catalogue management, lineage documentation, classifications, and ownership assignment processes.
* Understanding of access governance concepts, including role-based access control (RBAC) and access certification activities.
* Exposure to a regulated industry, preferably pharmaceutical, or awareness of data integrity principles in a compliance-focused environment.
* Snowflake SnowPro Core certification or active progress toward certification.
* Familiarity with data catalogue platforms.
* Basic Python or dbt experience supporting data transformation activities.
* Exposure to data lineage concepts or related tooling.
* Familiarity with enterprise data governance tools and practices.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage assigned tasks, meet deadlines, and raise blockers appropriately.
* Effective interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage data owners and business partners on routine governance matters.
* Conscientious, diligent, collaborative, reliable, and committed to accuracy in governance and documentation activities.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
  
  
**When & Where**
Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**Discover Your Role**

* Lead data quality workstreams within Snowflake, designing, implementing, and monitoring controls for assigned data domains while coordinating thresholds and remediation with data owners.
* Design and maintain auditable, version-controlled data quality rules using Snowflake Data Metric Functions, Dynamic Data Masking, and Row Access Policies aligned to business requirements.
* Monitor rule execution results, triage failures, and deliver exception reports and stakeholder dashboards that provide actionable insights to business teams, data stewards, and data owners.
* Maintain Data Quality Rule Registers and governance documentation that is current, audit-ready, and aligned to enterprise data governance standards.
* Lead catalogue maintenance and metadata management for assigned Snowflake assets within Horizon, ensuring consistent, business-meaningful documentation and inspection-ready lineage records.
* Produce lineage and provenance outputs that help Analytics and Data Science teams understand metric derivation, trustworthiness, and data usage.
* Manage day-to-day access governance activities for Snowflake role-based access control (RBAC) and attribute-based access control (ABAC) structures, supporting certification reviews, audit evidence preparation, and governed Data Marketplace operations.
* You proactively identify risks, continuously improve governance processes, and build productive relationships across technical and business teams while supporting leadership and team development.

**This Role Requires**

* Bachelor’s degree and 7+ years of relevant experience; advanced degree may be considered with 6+ years of relevant experience.
* Solid hands-on experience with Snowflake, including Data Metric Functions, Dynamic Data Masking, Row Access Policies, Tasks, Streams, and Snowpark.
* Strong SQL proficiency with the ability to write, review, and optimize data quality rules, logic, and data transformations.
* Experience designing and implementing data quality controls within a structured governance, compliance, or regulated environment.
* Strong understanding of data governance principles, including data quality dimensions, data ownership models, metadata management, and governance frameworks.
* Experience maintaining data catalogues and business and technical metadata standards, including data lineage documentation and validation.
* Experience managing Snowflake access governance, including RBAC, ABAC, access certification activities, and audit-ready documentation.
* Ability to manage defined workstreams and coordinate delivery across multiple collaborator groups with limited supervision.
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain data quality, governance, and lineage concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Experience in a regulated industry, preferably pharmaceutical, with familiarity with GxP data integrity requirements or equivalent frameworks.
* Snowflake SnowPro Core certification or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* Familiarity with Snowflake Horizon capabilities, including classification, governance policies, data sharing features, and metadata governance.
* Experience with Python or dbt for Snowflake-based data quality automation.
* Exposure to Data Marketplace or data-as-a-product operating models.
* Familiarity with enterprise data governance tooling.
* Diligent and dependable, with a commitment to delivering accurate, well-documented, audit-ready governance outputs.
* Strong problem-solving, risk identification, and continuous improvement attitude, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Data Governance, IT, Analytics, and business teams and support more junior colleagues.

title: Senior Manager, Data & Integrations
description:
**Job Description**
**Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations**
**Summary/Objective**
The Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations is the people leader and delivery owner for isolved's India-based data and integrations personnel. This role is fluent across both sides of the house: on the data side, this person needs to operate at the same architectural depth expected of isolved's Principal Data Architect, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling, data lineage, integrity, and governance, alongside hands-on fluency in Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch; and on the integrations side (system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, with deep API understanding, source and target schema design, master data management, and golden record configuration and management). This person owns hiring, coaching, and performance management for all India personnel on the data and integrations teams, and partners closely with U.S.-based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones so that the India team operates as a fully integrated extension of isolved's global data and integrations organization.
  
  
**Core Job Duties**

* Serve as the primary people leader for all India-based personnel on the data and integrations teams, spanning data platform, data engineering, and integration automation disciplines.
* Conduct 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning to support the growth of the India team.
* Hire, onboard, and build a high-performing, collaborative India-based data and integrations organization.
* Set clear expectations, provide direct feedback, and address performance issues effectively.
* Partner with U.S.-based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones.
* Ensure consistent standards, practices, and quality bar between the India and U.S. data and integrations teams.
* Own delivery of system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, including source and target schema design and mapping between isolved and its ecosystem of ERP, CRM, and partner systems.
* Own master data management and golden record configuration and management practices for the India team's scope of work, applying matching, deduplication, and survivorship standards.
* Maintain deep, working knowledge of APIs, including how to design, secure, and structure them for reliable, scalable, automated execution.
* Oversee data platform and analytics engineering work in India, including administration and support of Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch.
* Own data architecture standards for the India team's scope of work, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views, in partnership with the Principal Data Architect.
* Own data lineage, integrity, and cleanliness standards for India-delivered data work, and ensure the team applies data governance and cataloging practices (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Collibra, or Alation) consistently with global standards.
* Apply data quality and testing frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, dbt tests) to catch and resolve data issues before they reach downstream consumers.
* Ensure the India team's data pipeline work spans the full lifecycle, from ingestion through transformation, storage, and downstream consumption, including batch and, where appropriate, real-time/streaming patterns.
* Factor data lifecycle, retention, archival, and storage/compute cost optimization into architecture and delivery decisions.
* Maintain expert-level fluency in SQL and strong hands-on fluency in PySpark, sufficient to review, guide, and, when needed, directly contribute to complex data engineering and data architecture work.
* Track and balance capacity and workload across the India team, coordinating handoffs and shared work with U.S. shifts to keep delivery continuous across time zones.
* Represent the India team in global roadmap, planning, and prioritization discussions, bringing India-specific context and constraints into those conversations.
* Serve as an escalation point for production data and integration issues originating from or affecting the India team, coordinating incident response with U.S. counterparts as needed.
* Promote adoption of AI-assisted development and automation tools, and establish metrics to improve engineering productivity and delivery reliability.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with architecture, security, integrations, and analytics stakeholders in both India and the U.S. to ensure platform effectiveness and data integrity.

**Job Complexity**
Works on issues of significant scope and complexity where analysis of situations or data requires evaluation of a variety of factors, including cross-regional business and operational considerations. Establishes objectives and work plans for the India data and integrations organization, and exercises judgment in adapting global standards and priorities to local execution. Erroneous decisions or judgment could result in delays in schedules and may impact the overall success of the function. Develops and administers schedules, staffing plans, and performance requirements for the India team; may have budget responsibilities.
  
  
**Interaction**
Frequently interacts with senior management, functional peer group managers, and cross-regional counterparts in the U.S. and India, normally involving matters between functional areas, regions, or business units. Regularly leads a cooperative effort among India and U.S. team members to align on priorities, execution, and planning across time zones.
  
  
**Supervision**
Manages the coordination of the activities of the India data and integrations organization, with responsibility for results, including costs, methods, and staffing. Understands management practices, particularly around professional development and cross-regional team coordination, and is skilled at handling difficult management situations independently.
  
  
**Experience**
Typically requires a Bachelor's degree and 8-10 years of direct experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or integration engineering, with 4+ years of people management experience, including experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
  
  

* 8-10+ years of professional experience spanning both data engineering/data platform work and systems integration work.
* 4+ years of direct people management experience, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
* Proven experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams, ideally coordinating with U.S.-based counterparts across time zones.
* Well-versed in both the data side of the house (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Hightouch) and the integrations side of the house (system-to-system data integrations, ideally with Workato).
* Principal-level depth on the data architecture side: strong understanding of medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views.
* Expert-level SQL and strong hands-on experience with PySpark, sufficient to guide and review complex data engineering and data architecture work.
* Experience with data governance and cataloging tools (e.g., Microsoft Purview) and data quality/testing frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, dbt tests).
* Experience with Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse platform and Airflow or equivalent tooling for pipeline orchestration.
* Experience with data sharing technologies and patterns (e.g., Snowflake Secure Data Sharing, Databricks Delta Sharing), including the governance and access considerations they require.
* Understanding of data lifecycle management, retention/archival policies, and storage/compute cost optimization.
* Deep understanding of APIs, including designing, securing, and structuring them for reliable, automated execution.
* Strong understanding of source and target schema design and mapping for system-to-system integrations.
* Experience with master data management and golden record configuration and management, including matching, deduplication, and survivorship logic.
* Experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform).
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently address complex, cross-regional challenges.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across geographies, time zones, and cultures.
* Demonstrated ability to translate global priorities and standards into local execution plans.
* Preferred Qualifications:

+ Direct hands-on experience with Workato
+ Experience with Parabola.io or comparable low-code automation tools
+ Familiarity with streaming/real-time data technologies (e.g., Kafka, Event Hubs) as a complement to batch pipeline experience
+ Hands-on experience with big data ecosystem services such as Hadoop, Hive, HBase, YARN, and Spark
+ Professional services or customer-facing implementation experience
+ Experience operating in a follow-the-sun or globally distributed delivery model

**Position Details**
**Physical Demands:**
Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  
  
**Travel Required:**
Yes, up to 15% travel may be required, including periodic travel to the U.S. for team and stakeholder alignment.
  
  
**Work Authorization:**
Employee must be legally authorized to work in India.
  
  
**FLSA Classification:**
Exempt
  
  
**Location:**
India (Hybrid/Remote)
  
  
**Internal Job Title:**
Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations

[Insert Date]

isolved is an employee experience leader, providing intuitive, people-first HCM (Human Capital Management) technology. Our solutions are delivered directly or through our partner network to more than five million employees and 145,000 employers, who use them every day to boost performance, increase productivity, and accelerate results while reducing risk. Our HCM platform, isolved People Cloud, seamlessly connects and manages the employee journey across talent management, HR & payroll, workforce management and engagement management functions. No matter the industry, we help high-growth organizations employ, enable and empower their workforce by transforming employee experience for a better today and a better tomorrow. For more information, visit www.isolvedhcm.com.

All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. isolved is a progressive and open-minded meritocracy. If you are smart and good at what you do, come as you are. Visit www.isolvedhcm.com/careers for more information regarding our incredible culture and focus on our employee experience. title: Search Engineer
description:
**Role Description**

Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at UST.com.
  
  
**Job Description**
Summary -
  
  
We are hiring a Search Engineer to support and develop our UK search platforms. You will work across Apache Solr and Amazon OpenSearch (including Serverless), covering production support, search development, and a live Solr to OpenSearch migration.
  
  
This role suits someone who has worked L1, L2, and L3 search issues on a large distributed estate - Solr or Elasticsearch on EC2 or on-prem RHEL and can debug from logs, cluster state, and AWS CloudWatch or Splunk. Day-to-day work is hands-on: Bash, operational scripts, search changes, and using AI effectively to investigate and deliver faster.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own L1/L2/L3 search support: triage latency, indexing failures, cluster instability, auth/TLS, and query regressions, then drive RCA and lasting fixes.
* Debug distributed Solr and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch clusters on AWS EC2 and, where relevant, on-prem RHEL, using CloudWatch, Splunk, host logs, and cluster APIs.
* Develop and improve search: schemas, analyzers, indexing, queries, relevance, and search APIs.
* Contribute to the Solr to OpenSearch migration, including schema and query translation and relevancy and performance checks.
* Write and maintain Bash and operational automation for deploy, day-2 support, and incident response.
* Use AI and prompt engineering as part of daily engineering work - investigation, scripting, and delivery.
* Partner with product and platform teams on indexing pipelines, APIs, and AWS infrastructure.

**What You'll Bring**

* Strong production experience with Solr and/or Elasticsearch on EC2 or on-prem RHEL, including a large distributed, multi-node estate.
* A track record of resolving L1/L2/L3 search incidents, not only feature work.
* Solid Lucene fundamentals: schema, analyzers, relevancy, shards, replicas, and cluster operations.
* Hands-on Bash and comfort with AWS day-2 operations, especially CloudWatch, Splunk, or direct log analysis on RHEL hosts.
* Ability to develop search changes in Java and/or Python; SQL and RDBMS-backed indexing are useful.
* Practical use of AI tools and prompt engineering to speed up debugging, scripting, and implementation.
* Clear communication under incident pressure.

**Nice to have**

* OpenSearch, including Serverless, or a Solr to OpenSearch / Elasticsearch migration.
* A Solr major-version upgrade.
* Gatling, Locust, or similar performance testing.
* Custom search plugins or matching and relevance APIs.
* Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Harness, or Jenkins.
* C++, Okta/JWT, LDAP, SigV4, or TLS operational experience.
* AWS certification.

**What We Believe**
We’re proud to embrace the same values that have shaped UST since the beginning. Since day one, we’ve been building enduring relationships and a culture of integrity. And today, it's those same values that are inspiring us to encourage innovation from everyone, to champion diversity and inclusion and to place people at the centre of everything we do.

We will listen, learn, be empathetic and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.
  
  
**Humanity**
Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves.
  
  
**Integrity**
We honour our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
UST is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences, such as age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, religion, or sexual orientation.
  
  
All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, colour, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.

* Comply with all Company policies and procedures

title: Business Intelligent Engineer II, Amazon Shipping
description:
**Description**
Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant to ship items that are ordered on Amazon to any place on earth. There is a complex network of ways in which items move between vendor locations, Amazon warehouses, and customer locations as well as several intermediate locations through which packages travel before reaching the customer. With a scale of millions of packages, each with different attributes and delivery requirements, what results is a highly dense graph of nodes.
  
  
We have built a highly respected BI and Data Engineering team which is focused on solving complex problems in worldwide transportation using workflows, optimization algorithms, and machine learning systems. These are large-scale distributed systems handling millions of packages being shipped through the Amazon logistics network.
  
  
As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you will develop datasets, dashboards, reports, and visualizations using BI tools, and provide data-driven recommendations to support strategic planning within Amazon Shipping. Additionally, you will deliver across planned projects that will improve overall cost and profitability for the business.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Data Management and Integration: Collect, process, and manage large datasets from various sources, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and accessibility.
* Data Analysis: Analyze complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that can inform business decisions.
* Reporting and Visualization: Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to present data insights in an understandable and actionable format.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders to understand their data needs, provide data-driven recommendations, and support strategic planning.
* Tool and Technology Utilization: Utilize and stay updated with the latest BI tools and technologies to enhance data analysis and reporting capabilities.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description: OverviewSenior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer We're looking for a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to own the design, resilience, and day-to-day health of HealthEdge's infrastructure across AWS and our hybrid on-prem/Azure/GCP estate. This role sits at the intersection of cloud engineering and infrastructure engineering spanning AWS migration execution, disaster recovery, patching and platform currency, and the security/compliance controls that keep our security obligations intact. It's a hands-on senior IC role for someone who wants deep ownership of infrastructure resilience across a large, multi-account, multi-platform environment that's actively migrating off legacy on-prem infrastructure.Areas of Responsibility: Infrastructure and Hybrid Cloud ArchitectureOwn infrastructure across the environments including secure configuration baselines and patch management for OS images and on-prem hardwareDesign, build, and maintain infrastructure across AWS (primary), with supporting work in Azure and GCP, plus the on-prem estate still in active retirement Build and maintain reusable, auditable Infrastructure as Code for cloud deployments, and for remaining on-prem server deployment. Support cloud networking execution, VPC provisioning, security group standards, and related connectivity work. Manage storage across cloud and legacy on-prem storage as workloads migrate; contribute to on-prem retirement and datacenter decommissioning efforts. Support AWS migration execution for in-flight waves, including server deployments and resource change requests via IaC. Disaster Recovery & Resilience Own disaster recovery architecture and execution across cloud environments. Maintain DR solutions and backup strategy and run DR drills on a regular cadence; document gaps and drive remediation. Design for resilience from the start and treat recoverability as a first-class requirement, not an afterthought. Security, Compliance & Vulnerability Management Contribute to vulnerability management triage across infrastructure teams, threat detection, and infra security findings review. Support PHI/PII classification scanning, penetration test coordination, and security exception approvals. Maintain compliance controls; support HIPAA and SOC 2 audit readiness, access review and recertification, evidence collection, and change freeze coordination. Maintain EKS container runtime security sensor coverage as part of ongoing platform hardening. Cloud Infrastructure Operations Design and manage roles and cross-account access controls following least-privilege principles across multi-account, multi-cloud environments. Own cloud execution: load balancers, DNS (), VPC provisioning, and security group standards. Manage compute resources at scale with an eye toward right-sizing and long-term maintainability. Administer cloud storage and database services with attention to cost, performance, and resilience. Own infrastructure health, cost, and performance monitoring using native and third-party tooling, building the observability that lets issues surface before they become incidents. Administer and harden Linux and Windows Server environments across cloud and on-prem, including patching, performance tuning, troubleshooting, Active Directory integration, Group Policy, DNS, and certificate services. Manage hybrid identity and authentication across on-prem and cloud workloads, and maintain OS-level security baselines and hardening standards across the estate. CI/CD, Automation & Delivery Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines for secure, repeatable infrastructure deployments. Write automation to reduce manual toil and enforce operational consistency across cloud and on-prem environments. Take solutions from proof-of-concept to production with an eye toward long-term maintainability, not just getting it working once. Reliability, Monitoring & Incident Response Monitor, scale, and maintain production infrastructure with availability, performance, and security as top priorities. Participate in on-call rotation; serve as L2 escalation point for cross-team infrastructure support; lead root cause analysis and drive incident retrospectives to closure. Author and maintain runbooks that hold up under pressure, not just at handoff. Cost & Tagging Governance Contribute to FinOps efforts: identify and remediate cost anomalies, own tagging remediation against enterprise tagging standards, and make pragmatic cost/performance/resilience tradeoffs. AI-Enabled Engineering Use AI coding assistants to accelerate IaC development, scripting, and troubleshooting. Use AI tooling to draft first-pass runbooks, DR documentation, and incident retrospectives to validate and refine before publishing. Collaboration & Documentation Document architecture, DR runbooks, and standard operating procedures others can actually follow under pressure. Provide technical guidance to product teams on infrastructure resilience, migration sequencing, and recovery design. Required Qualifications5+ years of hands-on cloud infrastructure engineering experience, with deep expertise in AWS and in other cloud environments. Direct experience with disaster recovery design and execution. Strong Infrastructure as Code experience (CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation). Experience with containerized environments and Kubernetes/EKS, including version upgrade and lifecycle management. Linux and Windows Server administration experience, including patching and OS lifecycle management at scale. Solid IAM design experience, including cross-account access and least-privilege enforcement. Strong scripting ability (Python, Bash, or PowerShell). Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. Comfortable being the primary on-call and L2 escalation point for infrastructure incidents. Preferred QualificationsExperience operating in regulated environments (FedRAMP, HIPAA, SOC 2) and understanding of what that means for infrastructure and DR design specifically. AWS certification (Solutions Architect or SysOps, Associate or Professional). Experience with hybrid infrastructure, bridging on-prem virtualization with cloud-native services during active migration. Familiarity with DISA STIG or CIS benchmark hardening, and vulnerability management/triage workflows. FinOps or cost governance experience, including tagging standards enforcement. Healthcare technology or digital health platform background. Experience with AI-assisted engineering workflows as part of daily practice. Behaviors & Traits Raises risk early rather than waiting for it to become an incident. Comfortable with ambiguity in a large, multi-account, evolving cloud environment. Strong sense of ownership; closes gaps rather than escalating and waiting. Communicates technical tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

**Data Engineer**
with

**Python**
,

* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, and lakehouse concepts such as Delta Lake.
* Strong SQL skills for joins, window functions, data profiling, transformations, validations, and performance tuning.
* Good working knowledge of Python and PySpark, including Spark fundamentals such as partitioning, shuffle, caching, file formats, debugging, and optimization.
* Understanding of dimensional modeling concepts including facts, dimensions, star/snowflake schemas, and slowly changing dimensions (SCD).
* Exposure to GitHub, CI/CD, code reviews, branching, release practices, and engineering quality standards.
* Working knowledge of Docker and Terraform for deployment, runtime configuration, and cloud environment support.
* Ability to work in Agile teams, communicate clearly, collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, and take ownership of assigned deliverables.

**Primary Skills**
Python, PySpark, SQL, AWS, Databricks, GitHub, Data Lake, ETL/ELT and CI/CD
  
  
**Secondary Skills**
Dimensional modeling, Docker and Terraform

We are known as well-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What We Look For**

You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

Amazon Web Services (AWS), CI/CD, Databricks Platform, Data ETL, Data Lake, GitHub, PySpark, Python (Programming Language), SQL Databases

* Always On Availability Groups
* SQL Server Replication
* Backup and recovery strategies
* Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting for automation.
* Experience with Delphix (data virtualization and masking).
* Strong knowledge of AWS database services.
* Experience in database migrations and upgrades.
* Solid understanding of database security and compliance practices.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Exposure to Microsoft Azure (Azure SQL, Managed Instances).

* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. They will assist other engineers and developers in the use of open protocols and platform APIs, along with automation vendor platforms, for supporting the design and development and integrating of IT solutions with the automation platform(s). Working with IT Automation and other Platform architects to maintain and evolve the Automation Reference Architecture. The role works with internal technical specialists, architects, and external service providers to support the future direction of IT Automation. The incumbent will support the implementation of IT Automation products and provide subject-matter expertise to all IT Automation developers.

* Carry out and also improve system software development and maintenance tasks by updating the product design to automate routine system administration tasks using standard tools and software development practices.

Role Overview

Buxton Consulting is seeking a hands-on Senior Oracle Applications DBA with strong experience supporting Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) 11i, R12.1, and R12.2.x and Oracle Database versions up to and including 19c. The role involves administration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, patching, upgrades, and migrations across on-premises and cloud environments.

Strong troubleshooting skills and hands-on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) experience are mandatory.

Administer and support Oracle EBS 11i, R12.1, and R12.2.x application and database environments.

Perform EBS installation, configuration, patching, cloning, upgrades, and migrations.

Manage application-tier components, including concurrent managers, workflow services, Oracle Forms and Reports, Oracle HTTP Server, and Oracle WebLogic Server, as applicable to the EBS release.

Perform EBS patching using ADPATCH and R12.2 online patching using ADOP.

Administer Oracle Database versions up to and including 19c, maintaining compatibility with the applicable EBS release.

Troubleshoot complex application, database, and infrastructure issues and perform root cause analysis.

Monitor and optimize application and database performance, including SQL tuning and capacity planning.

Manage backup, recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery using RMAN, Oracle RAC, and Data Guard.

Support Oracle workloads on OCI and other cloud platforms, including AWS or Microsoft Azure.

Maintain security controls, monitoring, operational documentation, and recovery procedures.

Collaborate with application, infrastructure, development, and business teams to resolve production incidents and implement changes.

Mandatory Skills

Oracle Applications DBA

Strong hands-on administration and support experience with Oracle EBS 11i, R12.1, and R12.2.x.

Experience with EBS application and database tiers, including patching, cloning, configuration, upgrades, and migrations.

Hands-on experience with ADOP, ADPATCH, AutoConfig, and Rapid Clone.

Experience supporting concurrent processing, workflow, application services, and application-tier connectivity.

Strong understanding of EBS architecture and application/database dependencies.

Oracle Database Administration

Strong Oracle Core DBA experience with database versions up to and including Oracle Database 19c.

Hands-on expertise in:

Oracle RAC and ASM.

Oracle Data Guard.

Database and SQL performance tuning.

RMAN backup and recovery.

Database patching, upgrades, migrations, and cloning.

Database security, monitoring, and capacity management.

Troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis

Strong hands-on troubleshooting skills across Oracle EBS application tiers, Oracle databases, and cloud infrastructure.

Ability to diagnose and resolve production incidents, performance degradation, connectivity failures, patching errors, and backup/recovery failures.

Experience analyzing logs, identifying root causes, and implementing corrective and preventive actions.

Ability to independently manage critical incidents and communicate clearly throughout resolution.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Other Cloud Platforms

Mandatory hands-on OCI experience, including:

Compute, storage, networking, and Identity and Access Management (IAM).

Oracle database services and EBS deployments.

Monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery.

Cloud migrations and administration.

Experience supporting Oracle workloads on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or other cloud platforms.

Understanding of hybrid cloud connectivity, security, and operational support.

Operating Systems and Scripting

Strong Linux/Unix administration and troubleshooting skills relevant to Oracle environments.

Hands-on shell scripting experience for routine administration, monitoring, and automation.

Preferred Skills — Nice to Have

Microsoft SQL Server DBA experience, including administration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and troubleshooting.

AI-driven automation experience, including AI-assisted database monitoring, performance optimization, incident diagnosis, and automation of routine DBA tasks.

Oracle Exadata administration and performance optimization.

Automation using Python, Ansible, or similar tools.

Design and implementation of high-availability and disaster recovery architectures.

Experience with integrations between Oracle EBS and Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications.

Cloud cost optimization and infrastructure automation experience.

Communication and Professional Attributes

Exceptional communication, presentation, and documentation skills.

Ability to explain technical issues clearly to technical and business stakeholders.

A pleasant, proactive, collaborative, and professional attitude.

Strong ownership and the ability to work independently.
