title: Senior Administrator, Corporate Systems
description:
The Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB) Corporate Systems Senior Developer will be responsible for the end-to-end administration, deployment, and development of the ORMB application built on the Oracle Utilities Application Framework (OUAF). This role combines hands-on system administration — including fresh installations, environment provisioning, patch management, and release deployments — with Java-based development of enhancements, integrations, and batch processing solutions.
  
  
Working under the direction of the Technical Manager, this role requires frequent collaboration with functional business analysts, infrastructure/DBA teams, third-party vendors, and end users to ensure high availability, compliance, and continuous delivery of a quality finance/corporate systems application. The ideal candidate brings both deep administrative experience with ORMB/OUAF environments and strong Java development skills in large-volume financial systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* System Administration & Environment Management

+ Plan, execute, and document fresh installations of ORMB/OUAF across Development, QA, UAT, and Production environments on Linux/Unix servers

- Configure WebLogic application server, Oracle database connections, batch frameworks, and OUAF environment properties (ENVIRON.INI, SPLEBASE).
- Manage multi-environment topology including environment cloning, refresh, and rollback procedures.

+ Apply Oracle-released CPU patches, SPU patches, and product fix packs to ORMB/OUAF environments following change management procedures.

- Coordinate patch testing in lower environments before promoting to Production; maintain patch inventory and compliance registers.
- Use Oracle OPatch / OUAF patch utilities (e.g., FW patch scripts) and validate post-patch environment integrity.

+ Execute and oversee application deployments and release promotions across all environments using OUAF deployment utilities.

- Manage Configuration Migration (CM) packages, migration plans, and controlled rollouts via the OUAF Migration Assistant.
- Coordinate with DBAs for schema scripts, data migrations, and post-deployment validation.

+ Monitor application health, JVM performance, batch throughput, and WebLogic thread pools; tune configurations to meet SLA targets.
+ Maintain and update installation guides, runbooks, patch procedures, and environment-specific configuration documentation.

* Development & Enhancements

+ Design and develop custom ORMB components — algorithms, service scripts, BPA scripts, business objects, business services, and portal zones — using Java and the OUAF framework.
+ Build and maintain third-party integrations (e.g., tax engines, payment gateways, e-invoicing, ticketing systems) using REST/SOAP APIs and batch file-based patterns.
+ Develop and optimize batch programs for high-volume billing and financial transaction processing, including performance profiling and JVM-level tuning.
+ Collaborate with functional analysts and business stakeholders to gather requirements, propose solutions, and deliver enhancements aligned with business capabilities.

* Production Support & Operations

+ Provide Tier 2/3 production support for ORMB including incident triage, root cause analysis, and resolution of batch failures, data anomalies, and integration errors.
+ Run and schedule production batch jobs; maintain and modify interfaces, reports (BI Publisher), and scheduled tasks.
+ Perform year-end processing support, system upgrades, and general technical modifications with minimal business disruption.
+ Liaise with Oracle Support (SR management), infrastructure, and DBA teams to resolve platform-level issues.

* Collaboration & Governance

+ Work with external vendors and internal teams to evaluate system changes; participate in design reviews, propose solutions, and document outcomes.
+ Ensure all deployments and patches comply with change management, security, and audit policies.
+ Support the ORMB V8 upgrade and other strategic migration initiatives, contributing to parallel-run testing and validation activities.

**Knowledge And Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Systems required.
* 4+ years of experience with Oracle ORMB or CC&B, including hands-on administration of OUAF-based environments (installations, patching, deployments).
* 4+ years of strong Java development skills with demonstrated ability to build and extend OUAF/ORMB framework components.
* Experience installing and patching ORMB/OUAF on Linux/Unix servers; familiarity with WebLogic administration and JVM tuning.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database / SQL; ability to write and optimize queries against ORMB billing schema.
* Experience managing OUAF Configuration Migration (CM) packages and multi-environment promotion workflows.
* Ability to work independently and thrive in a high-profile environment while maintaining high attention to detail and quality.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with technical peers, business stakeholders, and third-party vendors.

**Preferred Knowledge And Experience**

* Familiarity with Oracle patch delivery mechanisms (My Oracle Support, OPatch) and WebLogic patching procedures.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines or scripted deployment automation for Java/OUAF applications.
* BI Publisher and/or Tableau experience is a plus.
* Financial industry experience with finance and/or accounting knowledge is beneficial.
* Experience with ORMB V8 (v8.x) and knowledge of differences from legacy CC&B / ORMB v2.x.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow or Jira integrations in enterprise environments.
* Ability to liaise with and build effective relationships with global teams across time zones.

title: Senior Delivery Consultant - Data, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Delivery Consultant specializing in Data to join our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) practice. You will be at the center of the most consequential shift in enterprise technology: making organizations truly AI-ready. Every agentic AI system, every foundation model grounded in enterprise knowledge, and every GenAI application that moves from prototype to production depends on the data layer beneath it - and that's what you build.
  
  
You will design and implement modern data platforms (lake, lakehouse, mesh), architect data pipelines that transform raw, fragmented data estates into governed, AI-ready assets; and design and implement enterprise RAG architectures, vector stores, semantic ontologies, and knowledge graph architectures that allow foundation models and AI agents to reason accurately, access data securely, and execute autonomously within regulated environments. You will work hands-on inside HCLS customer environments with complex data lineage, regulatory overlays (GxP, HIPAA, CDISC), and legacy systems, and ship production-grade data products that serve multiple downstream consumers, from ML model training to agentic orchestration layers.
  
  
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design and implement production-grade data pipelines, data lakes, lakehouses, and data mesh architectures within enterprise HCLS environments, integrating with legacy systems and existing data governance frameworks.
  
  
Build data products that serve multiple downstream applications and use cases — from AI/ML model training to agentic AI systems, ensuring data quality, lineage, and reliability at scale.
  
  
Operate with a high degree of autonomy within fast-moving delivery engagements, making judgment calls on data modeling, pipeline design, and architecture without waiting for perfect specifications or constant oversight.
  
  
Navigate complex data access, security, and privacy requirements unique to pharma and healthcare including GxP compliance constraints, HIPAA, and regulatory data governance frameworks.
  
  
Architect contextual knowledge layers, including ontologies and knowledge graphs leveraging AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and custom ontology extensions to equip AI agents with the vocabulary and guardrails to reason accurately and execute autonomously within regulated environments.
  
  
Collaborate across organizational boundaries to secure data access, understand source system context, and resolve data quality challenges with teams across customer IT, business, and partner organizations.
  
  
Deliver iteratively when requirements are ambiguous, translating incomplete business needs into well-architected data solutions that can evolve as customer understanding matures.
  
  
Apply AI-DLC (AI-accelerated Development Life Cycle) methodologies to data delivery to redesign data workflows to become AI-native for accelerated scale and pace.

Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience in advanced SQL & ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
* Knowledge of data engineering pipelines, cloud solutions, ETL management, databases, visualizations and analytical platforms
* Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Forward deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

**Company:**
Trida Labs

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**About Trida Labs**

Trida Labs builds AI-native products that help organizations work with enterprise data, analytics, and intelligent applications.

Our products include TridaPad, an AI-native data collaboration platform for querying, analyzing, visualizing, and managing enterprise data; AgentSQL, an agentic AI analytics solution for natural-language interaction with enterprise data; and TridaPad MCP Server, which enables AI assistants and MCP-compatible clients to interact with TridaPad capabilities.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with customers and turn business and technical requirements into working solutions using Trida Labs products.

You will work across customer discovery, data integration, configuration, testing, deployment, and production troubleshooting. You will understand customer workflows, data environments, security requirements, and business needs, then configure and integrate our products to solve real-world problems.

You will also support customer pilots, technical demonstrations, and pre-sales engagements, validating solutions against customer-specific use cases and collaborating with engineering teams when product-level changes are required.

This is a customer-facing engineering role focused on configuring and extending existing capabilities rather than building customer-specific forks.

**What You'll Do**

**1. Customer Discovery & Solution Design**

* Understand customer workflows, technical requirements, data environments, and operational constraints.
* Translate business requirements into practical Trida Labs solutions.
* Identify required data sources, integrations, permissions, configurations, and deployment requirements.
* Assess technical feasibility, explain trade-offs, and define reusable implementation approaches.

**2. Pre-Sales, Pilots & Proofs of Concept**

* Support technical discussions, product demonstrations, pilots, and proofs of concept.
* Demonstrate how TridaPad and AgentSQL address customer use cases.
* Configure representative customer environments and validate technical requirements.
* Identify integration, security, and deployment constraints and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.

**3. Product Implementation & Data Integration**

* Deploy and configure TridaPad and AgentSQL for customer requirements.
* Configure data sources, database connections, permissions, schemas, and analytics workflows.
* Integrate enterprise databases and platforms such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks.
* Understand customer data models, relationships, and business metrics.
* Validate data accessibility and troubleshoot connectivity, permission, schema, query, and integration issues.

**4. AI & Analytics Implementation**

* Configure existing AI and analytics capabilities for customer use cases.
* Adapt prompts, context, tools, and application workflows where appropriate.
* Validate natural-language analytics, SQL generation, analytical results, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries.
* Diagnose unreliable AI outputs and distinguish data, configuration, context, model, and product issues.
* Collaborate with specialist engineering teams when core product changes are needed.

**5. Security, Access & MCP Integrations**

* Support customer security questionnaires, technical reviews, and access requirements.
* Coordinate VPN, IP allowlisting, private connectivity, restricted network, and other environment-specific requirements.
* Support self-hosted deployments in customer cloud or on-premises environments where applicable.
* Apply least-privilege principles and follow requirements for handling production data, PII, credentials, logs, and debugging information.
* Configure and validate MCP integrations with AI assistants, internal applications, and customer workflows, including authentication, permissions, and tool access.

**6. Customer Evaluation & Validation**

* Build customer-specific golden question sets containing representative business questions, expected SQL, and verified analytical results.
* Test customer configurations against schemas, terminology, metrics, permissions, and real-world questions.
* Rerun relevant tests after product, model, prompt, or configuration changes.
* Validate SQL, analytics, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries against expected outcomes.
* Track regressions, communicate actionable findings, and maintain versioned customer-specific configuration artifacts.

**7. Deployment & Production Troubleshooting**

* Prepare implementation plans and technical validation checklists.
* Support deployments across development, staging, and production environments.
* Troubleshoot application, API, database, AI, integration, and deployment issues using logs, traces, errors, and reproduction steps.
* Validate fixes against customer-relevant scenarios and support releases, upgrades, and post-deployment checks.
* Coordinate infrastructure and platform-level issues with the appropriate engineering teams.

**8. Customer Feedback & Engineering Collaboration**

* Identify recurring customer problems and distinguish implementation needs from core product requirements.
* Provide structured feedback with technical details, reproduction steps, expected behavior, and customer impact.
* Identify opportunities to convert repeated implementation work into reusable product capabilities, tools, or documentation.
* Collaborate with AI, AI Agent, Data & AI, Backend, Platform, NLP/ML, and Product teams.
* Reduce customer-specific workarounds and avoid unnecessary product forks.

**Role Ownership**

* **Forward Deployed Engineer:**
  Owns customer discovery, solution design, implementation, integration, configuration, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer-facing technical delivery.
* **AI Engineer:**
  Owns reusable user-facing AI features and AI-powered application experiences.
* **AI Agent Engineer:**
  Owns agent orchestration, behavior, tool workflows, and core agent capabilities.
* **Data & AI Engineer:**
  Owns data connectivity, schema and metadata systems, semantic representations, and cross-database data correctness.
* **NLP/ML Engineer:**
  Owns model-level NLP and generation quality, including SQL-generation capabilities.
* **Platform Engineer:**
  Owns infrastructure, model access, deployment systems, observability, security, and platform-level connectivity.
* **Backend Engineer:**
  Owns core backend services, APIs, business logic, and shared application services.

The Forward Deployed Engineer configures and extends existing capabilities, validates customer deployments, and escalates core product changes to the appropriate teams rather than maintaining customer-specific forks.

**Customer Engagement Expectations**

* Work directly with customers across different technical and business environments.
* Support customer meetings and deployments across relevant time zones when required.
* Be willing to travel for customer meetings, workshops, deployments, and go-live activities when necessary.
* Manage multiple implementation activities while maintaining clear priorities and communication.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, technical consulting, or a related technical role.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Experience with APIs, databases, backend services, enterprise applications, and data integrations.
* Strong understanding of data workflows, SQL, and technical troubleshooting.
* Experience working with customers, stakeholders, or cross-functional technical teams.
* Familiarity with LLMs, Generative AI, and AI-powered applications.
* Ability to translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate issues using logs, errors, configurations, and reproduction steps.
* Strong communication skills and comfort supporting customer environments and production deployments.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and competing priorities effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Technical Implementation.
* Experience supporting product demonstrations, pilots, or proofs of concept.
* Experience with AI analytics, natural-language-to-SQL, or enterprise data applications.
* Experience with AI agents, tool calling, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
* Experience with MCP and AI assistant integrations.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker and cloud or deployment platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Render, or Vercel.
* Experience with production deployments, AI evaluation, regression testing, observability, or production AI troubleshooting.

**Key Skills**

Python | SQL | APIs | Databases | Enterprise Data | System Integration | Generative AI | LLMs | AI Applications | Natural-Language-to-SQL | Data Analytics | AI Agents | MCP | Docker | Cloud | Customer Deployment | Production Troubleshooting | Technical Implementation | Technical Communication

**Why Join Trida Labs?**

At Trida Labs, you will work directly on real AI systems solving enterprise data and analytics problems.

You will collaborate with customers and engineering teams across solution design, AI implementation, enterprise data integration, evaluation, production troubleshooting, and product improvement—helping turn real customer requirements into reliable, reusable product capabilities.

**Equal Opportunity**

Trida Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Cloud Engineer, you will play a crucial role in moving an organization's data, applications, and infrastructure from on-premises environments to cloud platforms. This role involves a combination of technical expertise, strategic planning, and project management.
  
  
**What Will You Do In This Role**

* Evaluate the existing IT infrastructure and applications to determine cloud readiness.
* Create a comprehensive migration strategy and roadmap.
* Select the appropriate cloud platform and deployment model.
* Execute the migration plan, including data transfer, application rehosting, replat forming, or refactoring.
* Develop, document, and implement changes based on the requests for change. Apply change control procedures, tools, techniques, and processes to manage and report on change requests.
* Contribute to the availability management process and its operation. Perform defined availability management tasks.
* Contribute to capacity modelling and planning while supporting the design of service component capacity.
* Continuously monitoring and optimizing the cloud environment for performance, cost-efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Work within a matrix organizational structure, reporting to both the functional manager and the project manager.
* Participate in project planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring alignment with both functional and project goals.

**What Should You Have**
Educational requirement is mandatory. The years of experience for
**R2 is fixed to 3-7 years**
,
**do not alter**

**Primary and Secondary – this structure must be maintained**
to support Hired Score screening.
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
* 3-7 years of hands-on technical experience in migrating workloads to cloud-based environments.

**Primary Skills (must-have)**

* Cloud Migration Engineering – end-to-end migration of applications, data, and infrastructure from on premises to cloud platforms
* AWS Cloud Expertise (Primary focus – ~90%) – hands-on experience with EC2, RDS, EMS, CI/CD pipelines, and GitHub integration
* Cloud Migration Strategy & Planning – assessing cloud readiness, defining migration roadmaps, and selecting appropriate deployment models (On-prem to Cloud / Cloud to Cloud).
* Migration Execution – rehosting, re-platforming, and refactoring applications based on business and technical requirements
* Infrastructure as Code (IAC) using Terraform for automated, scalable, and repeatable cloud deployments
* Change Management & Control – implementing and managing change requests using defined processes, tools, and governance standards
* Cloud Operations & Optimization – continuous monitoring and optimization for performance, cost efficiency, and resource utilization
* Availability & Capacity Management – supporting service availability requirements and contributing to capacity planning and modelling
* Project Execution in Matrix Environments – working across functional and project teams to deliver migration initiatives successfully

**Secondary Skills (nice To Have)**

* Azure Cloud Exposure (~10%) for hybrid or multi‑cloud migration scenarios
* CI/CD Tools & Automation – GitHub, pipeline setup, and deployment automation in cloud environments
* Cloud Native Concepts & Best Practices – ongoing awareness of evolving cloud technologies and architectural patterns
* Security & Compliance Awareness during cloud migration and operations
* Monitoring & Performance Tuning of migrated workloads
* Documentation & Technical Reporting for migration plans, change requests, and operational procedures
* Industry Domain Exposure – Bio‑Science, Healthcare, Pharma, Retail, and Logistics (preferred)
* AWS Certifications (preferred) to validate cloud expertise
* Experience with AI tools like Gemini, Claude and Copilot.

**Who We Are**
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been inventing for life, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. description:
**About Us**
As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
  
  
With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  
Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
Ensuring processes are set up, operate efficiently and reliably, including data quality monitoring, automation development, and KPI reporting. Act as processual liaison between BMT operations and SAP COE, enabling data-driven decision-making and continuous process optimization.
  
  
Data Handover Process Design & Optimization
  
  

* Conduct current-state assessment of LoB billing data flows (interviews, process mapping, gap analysis)
* Design future-state data handover process with clear steps, roles (RACI), validation gates, and submission deadlines
* Develop and pilot to validate approach, select optimal solution (or hybrid) based on data quality, LoB effort reduction, scalability, and cost
* Deploy selected solution for Wave 1 (LoB 1) and refine for Waves 2-3 based on lessons learned

Data Quality Management
  
  

* Define "complete data" checklists by pricing type (fixed-fee, variable, basis points, T&E, complex)
* Design automated data validation rules (completeness, accuracy, consistency checks)
* Monitor data submissions for anomalies and quality issues
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies impacting invoice accuracy
* Coordinate with LoB operations teams on data quality improvements and training needs

Process Documentation & Knowledge Management
  
  

* Document end-to-end billing processes (as-is and to-be)
* Create standard operating procedures (SOPs) for data submission, validation, exception handling
* Develop data submission calendars, templates, and user guides for LoB teams
* Maintain process documentation repository ensuring version control and accessibility
* Support AD Academy with data handover training materials and LoB workshops

Reporting & Analytics
  
  

* Generate weekly data quality reports for PMO Lead and monthly summaries for Steering Committee
* Perform ad-hoc analysis supporting business questions

Stakeholder Coordination & Change Management
  
  

* Partner with LoB operations teams to co-design data handover workflows respecting their constraints
* Conduct LoB workshops training regional teams on new data submission processes
* Facilitate dry-run billing cycle validating end-to-end data flow
* Escalate chronic data quality issues to LoB Leaders and PMO Lead

**Your Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, or related field
* 4-6 years experience in business process analysis, operations improvement, or data management (finance/billing domain preferred)
* Strong process mapping and optimization skills (Lean, Six Sigma Green Belt preferred)
* Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, macros, Power Query)
* Experience with data quality frameworks, validation rules, and reconciliation processes
* Familiarity with automation tools (UiPath, Power Automate, or similar RPA platforms)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
* Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills (ability to work with LoB operations teams)
* SAP FI/AR knowledge helpful

**Key Compentencies**

* Process mapping and optimization (SIPOC, value stream analysis, workflow design)
* Data analysis and validation (quality frameworks, error taxonomies, reconciliation)
* Business analysis (requirements gathering, solution design, feasibility assessment)
* Stakeholder collaboration and facilitation (workshops, training, change management)
* Documentation and knowledge management (SOPs, templates, user guides)
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving
* Communication (translating technical data concepts for operational audiences)

**What We Offer**
We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
  
  
Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
  
  
**Our Global Benefits Also Include**

* Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location

Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

NTT seeing a skilled Oracle Middleware WebLogic / SOA and Oracle Database Administrator to manage, maintain, and optimize application in Non-Prod and production environments. In this hybrid role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end administration of Oracle Fusion Middleware SOA / WebLogic application . You will ensure high availability, security, and peak performance across production, testing, and development environments

* Install, configure, provision, and support Oracle WebLogic server environments and Oracle Fusion Middleware stacks
* Perform ongoing application environment upgrades, security patch applications (CPU/SPU), and technology stack refreshes.
* Support OIPA (Oracle Insurance Policy Admin), JAVA applications, manage middle-tier certificates, and administer SSL configuration
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to application configuration, JVM tuning, and server workloads

* Collaborate with internal and external teams to manage the environment, network support and upgrade activities
* Support Developers and application configurators for Application code deployments, performance troubleshooting and rewriting SQL statements

* 5+ years of hands-on experience as an Oracle Middleware administrator
* 3+ years of Oracle Application DBA
* In-depth knowledge of WebLogic Server architecture, domain configuration, monitoring and middle-tier certificate management.
* 5+ years of experience managing Middleware applications in Linux Operating System, preferably Oracle Linux
* Proven proficiency with Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, Data Guard, and RMAN.
* Oracle Insurance Policy Admin experience is a plus

title: Senior Data Management Specialist
description:
**Senior Data Management Specialist**

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Experience:**
7+ Years

**Role Type:**
Data Management / Data Analysis / Business Intelligence

**Industry:**
Banking / Financial Services

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced
**Senior Data Management Specialist**
with 7+ years of experience in data discovery, data analysis, data profiling, and data management, preferably within the banking or financial services industry.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of
**consumer banking products and business processes**
, excellent
**SQL and data analysis skills**
, and hands-on experience working with business intelligence tools and enterprise database platforms. The candidate should be comfortable exploring large and complex datasets, identifying data patterns and issues, and translating business requirements into meaningful data insights.

This role requires strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, collaboration skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities

Data Discovery & Analysis

* Perform detailed
  **data discovery, exploration, profiling, and analysis**
  across multiple enterprise data sources.
* Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, relationships, anomalies, and data quality issues.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into data analysis and discovery activities.
* Investigate data across multiple systems and sources to understand how information is captured, transformed, stored, and consumed.
* Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improving data quality and usability.
* Conduct root-cause analysis for data-related issues and provide actionable recommendations.
* Support business and technology teams with data-driven insights and analysis.

SQL & Data Profiling

* Develop and execute complex
  **SQL queries**
  for data extraction, validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analysis.
* Perform data profiling to understand data structures, completeness, accuracy, consistency, and relationships.
* Work with large datasets and optimize queries where required for efficient analysis.
* Perform data reconciliation across multiple database systems and applications.
* Validate data against business rules and expected outcomes.
* Document findings, data relationships, assumptions, and analysis results.

Business Intelligence & Data Analysis Tools

* Use commonly adopted
  **Business Intelligence and data analysis tools**
  such as Tableau, SAS, Oracle, Microsoft tools, or similar platforms.
* Perform data exploration and analysis using both SQL and non-SQL tools and techniques.
* Create or support analytical views, reports, dashboards, and data extracts where required.
* Interpret data from multiple sources and communicate findings to technical and business stakeholders.
* Support data-driven decision-making by providing accurate and well-structured analysis.

Database & Technology Environment

* Work with multiple database management systems, including:
* Amazon Redshift
* Oracle
* Microsoft SQL Server
* Other relational and enterprise database platforms
* Work across different operating systems, including
  **Windows and Unix/Linux**
  environments.
* Understand database structures, schemas, tables, relationships, keys, and data dependencies.
* Investigate data across heterogeneous technology environments.
* Collaborate with engineering and technology teams to understand upstream and downstream data flows.

Consumer Banking & Financial Services

* Apply strong knowledge of
  **consumer banking and financial products**
  while performing data analysis and discovery.
* Understand banking business processes and how they impact data creation, processing, and consumption.
* Analyze data in the context of banking products, customer journeys, accounts, transactions, and related business processes.
* Work closely with business stakeholders to understand financial services requirements and translate them into data analysis activities.
* Ensure analysis and recommendations align with business objectives and applicable financial services practices.

Data Management & Data Design

* Support enterprise data management initiatives and data-related projects.
* Contribute to data design activities, including understanding data models, structures, relationships, and dependencies.
* Assist with defining and documenting data requirements and business rules.
* Support data governance, data quality, and data management activities as required.
* Identify opportunities to improve data consistency, accessibility, and reliability.
* Partner with data architects, engineers, analysts, and business teams on data management initiatives.

Agile Delivery

* Participate in Agile development and delivery processes.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Developers, QA teams, and other stakeholders.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog discussions, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Provide data analysis and technical inputs throughout the project lifecycle.
* Take ownership of assigned deliverables and ensure timely completion.

Stakeholder Collaboration

* Work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Communicate complex data findings in a clear and understandable manner.
* Collaborate across teams to resolve data issues and deliver business outcomes.
* Take initiative in identifying potential issues and recommending solutions.
* Manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
* Build strong working relationships with cross-functional teams.

Required Skills & Experience

* **7+ years of professional experience**
  in data management, data analysis, data discovery, data profiling, business intelligence, or a closely related field.
* Strong understanding of
  **consumer banking products and business processes**
  .
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **SQL**
  and data analysis/profiling.
* Experience performing data discovery and analysis using one or more commonly used BI/data analysis tools such as:
* Tableau
* SAS
* Oracle
* Microsoft data/BI tools
* Similar enterprise data analysis platforms
* Strong understanding of data structures, relationships, data quality, and profiling concepts.
* Experience working with multiple database management systems, such as:
* Amazon Redshift
* Oracle
* Microsoft SQL Server
* Other enterprise relational databases
* Experience working in
  **Windows and Unix/Linux**
  environments.
* Ability to analyze data from multiple sources and identify discrepancies or patterns.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and take initiative.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage complex data analysis assignments and deliver accurate results.

Desirable Skills & Experience

* Experience with
  **data exploration using both SQL and non-SQL tools and techniques**
  .
* Experience with data profiling and data quality analysis.
* Experience in
  **data design or enterprise data management**
  .
* Experience working with data models, schemas, and data lineage.
* Knowledge of data governance and data quality practices.
* Experience working in an
  **Agile/Scrum environment**
  .
* Previous experience in the
  **financial services or banking industry**
  .
* Experience working with consumer banking or related financial products.
* Experience collaborating with large enterprise technology and business teams.
* Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and modern data technologies is an advantage.

Key Competencies

* Data Discovery & Exploration
* Data Analysis & Profiling
* Advanced SQL
* Data Quality & Validation
* Business Intelligence
* Database Analysis
* Consumer Banking Domain Knowledge
* Data Management
* Data Design
* Analytical Problem Solving
* Stakeholder Management
* Agile Delivery
* Attention to Detail
* Communication & Collaboration
* Ownership and Initiative

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a
**senior data professional with strong SQL and analytical capabilities**
, combined with practical experience in enterprise data environments and a solid understanding of consumer banking. The candidate should be able to independently explore complex datasets, work across multiple databases and tools, identify data issues, and communicate meaningful findings to both technical and business stakeholders.

title: Contract Position : Posgresql Systems Integration Senior Analyst
description:
Experience: 5 - 15 years
  
  
Max Experience: 15
  
  
Our client is a Palo Alto–based AI infrastructure and talent platform founded in 2018. It helps companies connect with remote software developers using AI-powered vetting and matching technology. Originally branded as the “Intelligent Talent Cloud,”enabled companies to “spin up their engineering dream team in the cloud” by sourcing and managing vetted global talent. In recent years, they have evolved to support AI infrastructure and AGI workflows, offering services in model training, fine-tuning, and deployment—powered by their internal AI platform, ALAN, and backed by a vast talent network. They reported $300 million in revenue and reached profitability. Their growth is driven by demand for annotated training data from AI labs, including major clients like OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and Meta.
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Title: Posgresql Systems Integration Senior Analyst
  
  
Location: Pan India
  
  
Experience: 5+ yrs
  
  
Employment Type: Contract to hire
  
  
Work Mode: Hybrid
  
  
Notice Period: Immediate joiners
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
Manage PostgreSQL databases across multiple lifecycle environments, including Development, QA, UAT, Production, and Disaster Recovery.
  
  
Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain PostgreSQL database environments.
  
  
Monitor database health, performance, availability, and capacity utilizing native PostgreSQL tools and enterprise monitoring platforms.
  
  
Perform database performance tuning, query optimization, and troubleshooting of complex performance issues.
  
  
Design, implement, and support High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions using technologies such as EFM, Patroni, PgBouncer, Replication, and DR architectures.
  
  
Manage PostgreSQL replication technologies including Streaming Replication, Logical Replication, and WAL management.
  
  
Perform database backup, restoration, point-in-time recovery (PITR), and disaster recovery testing.
  
  
Independently analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve database incidents, outages, and performance bottlenecks.
  
  
Plan and execute PostgreSQL version upgrades, migrations, and platform modernization initiatives.
  
  
Automate routine database administration tasks using Shell, Python, Ansible, or other scripting and automation tools.
  
  
Maintain database security, user access management, auditing, and compliance requirements.
  
  
Participate in on-call support and provide 24x7 support for critical production systems.
  
  
Support application deployments, release management, and database changes during maintenance windows.
  
  
Create and maintain operational documentation, standard operating procedures, and technical knowledge articles.
  
  
Collaborate directly with customers, application teams, infrastructure teams, cloud teams, and business stakeholders.
  
  
Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to peers and junior database administrators.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.
  
  
Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.
  
  
**Who You Are**
You are a Senior Software Development Engineer L4 who brings strong reporting and data experience to design, build, and optimize scalable systems that power analytics, business intelligence, and reporting capabilities for clients. You work as a senior technical contributor, helping shape architecture, engineering standards, and delivery practices across the team. You use sound judgment, deep technical expertise, and a data-driven mindset to build secure, reliable, high-performance solutions that support business outcomes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design resilient, secure distributed systems at scale from initial concept through implementation.
* Lead technical decisions that raise the engineering bar for scalability, resiliency, security, and overall engineering excellence.
* Discover, review, and influence evolving designs, architecture, and standards for building and delivering services and solutions.
* Investigate, design, and implement innovative technologies that expand infrastructure capabilities through robust, scalable solutions.
* Develop and execute designs for complex systems using strong engineering analysis, testing, and optimization.
* Create, gather, and use metrics to manage server fleets and complex computing systems, driving automation, performance improvements, and operational efficiency.
* Own detailed design, analysis, testing, and optimization to ensure solutions are reliable, maintainable, and high performing.
* Mentor and onboard new team members to support effective ramp-up and ongoing team success.
* Collaborate with engineers, internal services across Inovalon, and external customers to understand requirements and maintain a tight, data-driven feedback loop.
* Participate in an on-call rotation to support critical issues outside standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, and respond within defined SLAs.

**What You'll Need**

* Minimum 5+ years of related professional experience; prior software engineering experience preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* Strong programming skills in object-oriented programming languages, including .NET and C#, with experience in RESTful API development and EF Core mapping.
* Proficiency with Angular and TypeScript.
* Experience working with SQL, RDS, and DynamoDB.
* Solid understanding of software and database design patterns.
* Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and design for performance, scalability, and availability.
* Experience with cloud-native AWS managed services, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD.
* Experience working with OAuth2, JWT, and Secrets Manager.
* Demonstrate growth potential and learning agility by quickly learning new technologies, expanding technical scope, and applying new knowledge to improve systems and team outcomes.
* Demonstrate leadership by influencing technical direction, collaborating effectively across engineering and partner teams, mentoring others, and working through differing viewpoints constructively.
* Demonstrate adaptability by adjusting priorities and technical approaches in response to changing requirements, evolving architecture, and operational demands while staying focused on outcomes.
* Demonstrate creative thinking by identifying practical, innovative ways to solve infrastructure, reporting, and scalability challenges that create business value.
* Demonstrate analytical skills by using metrics, data, and sound engineering logic to evaluate tradeoffs, solve complex problems, and support technical decisions.

**Our Shared Commitments**

* Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement;
* Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and
* Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer.

**Work Environment**

* This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.

*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)*
*If you don’t meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
*By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.*
*Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirement.*
*To review the legal requirements, including all labor law posters, please visit this*
*link*
*To review the California Consumer Privacy Statement: Disclosures for California Residents, please visit this*
*link*
*Work Location: If the US position is listed as remote, employees who reside within a 40-mile radius of one of our office locations in Tampa, FL; Canonsburg, PA; or Bowie, MD will follow a hybrid work schedule and are expected to work in the office two days per week (Tuesdays and Wednesdays).*

title: Oracle Technical Consultant
description:
We are looking for an experienced Oracle EBS Techno-Functional Analyst to support a Microsoft Fabric-based data platform to bridge the gap between Oracle EBS functional knowledge and downstream BI/ETL delivery, working closely with the onshore/offshore Fabric data engineering and Power BI development team.

Key Responsibilities:

Serve as the subject matter expert on Oracle EBS table structures, data relationships, and business processes across Financials and Projects modules. Partner with Fabric data engineers and PBI developers to validate source-to-target mappings, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and explain EBS business logic behind transactional and reference data, ensuring accuracy and completeness.

Assist Power BI developers in interpreting EBS-sourced datasets to ensure reports and dashboards reflect correct business context.

Investigate and resolve data quality issues, mapping gaps, and reconciliation discrepancies between EBS and Fabric.

Document EBS table structures, data lineage, and business rules to build institutional knowledge and reduce dependency on individual resources.

Collaborate with client finance, procurement, and IT stakeholders to clarify functional requirements and validate reporting outputs.

Financial Core: Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, General Ledger, Secondary Ledgers , Project Accounting, Time Sheets, Colleague Expenses, People Performance

Required Skills & Experience: 10+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle EBS (Financials and/or Projects modules), including strong knowledge of underlying table structures and data flows.

Proven experience translating EBS functional/business processes into technical data requirements for BI/analytics teams.

Exposure to ETL/data pipeline and power BI concepts; prior exposure to Microsoft Fabric is a strong plus. Experience with SQL for data investigation and validation.Strong communication skills to work across functional and technical teams, including direct client interaction.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
TJX Companies
  
  
At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About TJX:**
TJX is a Fortune 100 company that operates off-price retailers of apparel and home fashions. TJX India - Hyderabad is the IT home office in the global technology organization of off-price apparel and home fashion retailer TJX, established to deliver innovative solutions that help transform operations globally. At TJX, we strive to build a workplace where our Associates’ contributions are welcomed and are embedded in our purpose to provide excellent value to our customers every day. At TJX India, we take a long-term view of your career. We have a high-performance culture that rewards Associates with career growth opportunities, preferred assignments, and upward career advancement. We take well-being very seriously and are committed to offering a great work-life balance for all our Associates.
  
  
**What You Will Discover**

* Inclusive culture and career growth opportunities
* Global IT Organization which collaborates across U.S., Canada, Europe and Australia
* Challenging, collaborative, and team-based environment

**What You Will Do**
Enterprise Data & Analytics thrives on strong relationships with our business partners and working diligently to address their needs which support TJX India growth and operational stability. On this tightly knit and fast-paced solution delivery team you will be constantly challenged to stretch and think outside the box.
  
  
**You will have a real opportunity to be a part of TJX’s transformation to a data driven culture, with the autonomy to work with the business to unlock game changing insights that drive business value. We have modernized our technology stack to focus on the cloud and top tier tools. We are looking for someone who embraces the use of technology to build, manage, and govern data.**
As a Senior Engineer at TJX India, you will work with a team that partners with the EDA Data Foundation team and delivers products for one or more customer analytics product teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design end-to-end data engineering solutions on Snowflake and Azure Data Lake
* Design and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using ETL (Talend), Databricks, Azure Data Factory, and Snowflake
* Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs and implementations.
* Drive performance tuning, cost optimization, reliability, and scalability of data pipelines.
* Collaborate with data, analytics, and visualization teams to deliver high-quality data products.
* Develop and maintain detailed functional and technical documentation.
* Support solutioning efforts across design, testing, and implementation phase.
* Ensure data governance, security, and privacy standards are embedded into data pipelines.
* Contribute to data modernization initiatives by defining patterns, standards, and best practices.
* Evaluate and adopt new tools and technologies to improve data engineering capabilities.

Liaises and coordinates with business and IT stakeholders including offshore team members. * Gather and analyze business requirements; design, develop, test and implement technical solutions to fulfill requirements of supply chain, manufacturing, and planning areas; and provide post implementation maintenance and support

* Support System Functional testing, End-To-End Integration testing, Regression testing, and User Acceptance testing within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

* Ensure compliance to Release management, Change management and configuration management processes.

* Respond, analyze and resolve production incidents within SLAs, perform routine maintenance tasks, and monitor / enhance performance of scheduled programs to ensure business continuity.
* Automate and maintain Integration of Oracle EBS / VCP modules with other internal and external systems.
* Participate in following activities:
* Analyze and plan Oracle EBS / VCP upgrades (i.e. Family Packs)
* Create and resolve service requests in collaboration with ‘My Oracle Support’
* Provide production support as per Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Continuously improve system performance and reliability by identifying opportunities for root cause analysis and automation
* Facilitate in establishing standards and Best Practices for software design, development and Unit Test and lead team to leverage these standards and best practices to deliver high quality and cost effective solutions.
* Use systematic techniques and process modeling tools for effective system specifications and design - like Use-case scenarios, Activity Diagrams, Data-flow Diagramming etc.

**Required Education / Experience / Skills**

* Educations:
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent related experience
* Experience
* 10+ years of experience building and supporting solutions based on Oracle EBS Supply Chain / VCP R12 (Advanced Supply Chain Planning, Demantra, and Inventory Optimization) in global environment – with at least 2or 3 full lifecycle implementations or 3+ years of monitoring, maintaining, enhancing, integrating and upgrading
* Awareness or Green Belt certification in Lean Six Sigma or APICS (CPIM, CIRM) certification preferred
* Technical Skills:

* Ability to analyze and resolve supply-demand exceptions and issues as per SLAs
* Experience with SQL\*Plus, SQL\*Loader, Data Loader, Export/Import, TKPROF, Oracle scheduler, Advanced Queues, Object management

* Professional Certification(s) like Supply Chain industry or Oracle E-Business Suite R12 (strongly desired)

25% of time – mostly during project milestones, kaizen or similar events

* Drive adoption of scalable, governed data marts that balance self-service enablement with data integrity, security, and compliance.

I

title: Snowflake Admin
description:
**What you will do**

**Platform administration**

* **Accounts and environments**
  Manage separate Snowflake accounts for development, testing and production, and keep their setup consistent.
* **Access and security**
  Build and maintain role-based access (RBAC). Manage single sign-on and user provisioning with the corporate identity provider (SAML/OIDC and SCIM). Set up key-pair authentication for service accounts and network policies.
* **Data protection**
  Apply Snowflake Horizon governance features: object tagging, masking policies and row access policies for sensitive data.
* **Cost and performance**
  Size and tune warehouses, set resource monitors and budgets, and report on credit usage. Find and fix slow or costly queries.
* **Infrastructure as code**
  Manage Snowflake objects through version-controlled scripts (for example Terraform or schemachange), not by hand.
* **Monitoring and support**
  Set up alerts, track failed jobs and logins, handle incidents, and write runbooks so others can follow the same steps.
* **Data sharing**
  Configure secure data sharing between accounts so non-production environments can use production data safely.

**Data engineering**

* **Source onboarding**
  Onboard enterprise business data sources (for example ERP, commerce, marketing, supply chain and SaaS applications) using Fivetran and Snowflake Openflow.
* **Ingestion operations**
  Configure and run connectors, and handle schema changes, re-syncs, failures and freshness targets.
* **Custom and streaming feeds**
  Build Openflow flows for sources without a ready-made connector, including files, APIs, databases and event streams.
* **Pipelines and orchestration**
  Build and schedule pipelines using Snowflake Tasks, Streams, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe and dbt Projects on Snowflake.
* **Data quality at landing**
  Add row-count, freshness and completeness checks so problems are caught before data reaches users.
* **CI/CD**
  Build deployment pipelines that promote code from development to test to production safely.

**Must have**

* 4+ years of hands-on Snowflake administration: RBAC design, warehouses, resource monitors, account parameters and user management.
* Had worked on enterprise companies who has implemented Snowflake as DATA Hub.
* Hands-on experience with Fivetran or a similar managed ingestion tool, including troubleshooting sync failures.
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake Openflow or Apache NiFi, building and running data flows.
* SnowPro Core certification.
* Strong SQL and working Python.
* Experience with Git-based workflows and CI/CD for data platforms.
* Working knowledge of AWS as it relates to Snowflake: S3, IAM roles and storage integrations.
* Clear written English and the discipline to document what you build.

**Nice to have**

* SnowPro Advanced: Administrator or Architect certification.
* Terraform, schemachange or similar tools for managing Snowflake objects.
* Snowpipe Streaming, Kafka or other streaming ingestion.
* Experience with a secrets manager for service credentials.

title: Lead, Data Warehouse
description:
**About The Company**
Consilio stands as the global leader in eDiscovery, document review, flexible legal talent, and legal advisory & transformation consulting services. With its Consilio Complete suite of capabilities, the company empowers multinational law firms and corporations using innovative software, cost-effective managed services, and deep legal and regulatory industry expertise .
  
  
**Work Model**
- 3 days WFO/2 days WFH(Hybrid)
  
  
**Shift**
- 2 PM - 11 PM
  
  
**Benefits**
- Free pick & drop, free meals & more
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior SQL Engineer to join our Enterprise Data Warehouse team. This role will focus on advanced data analysis, prototype dataset development, data mart design, and investigative SQL work across enterprise source systems.
  
  
The ideal candidate is not simply a SQL developer. This person must have deep curiosity about data, strong analytical instincts, and the ability to determine whether query output “looks right” based on business context, source system behavior, data patterns, and reconciliation logic. This role requires someone who can work effectively even when documentation is incomplete or unavailable.
  
  
This position is expected to work closely with Data Engineering, Data Analysis, Business Systems Analysis, Product, and Engineering leadership.
  
  
**Critical Success Factors**
This role requires more than only years of SQL experience. The successful candidate must demonstrate:
  
  

* Curiosity: Actively investigates data rather than waiting for perfect documentation.
* Judgment: Can determine whether results make sense based on patterns and business context.
* Persistence: Will search through tables, relationships, and outputs until the data story is clear.
* Ownership: Takes responsibility for producing reliable, explainable datasets.
* Analytical depth: Understands not just how to write SQL, but how to reason through data.
* Practical prototyping ability: Can quickly build usable datasets that help shape future warehouse or reporting solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze complex enterprise data across multiple source systems to support reporting, analytics, and data warehouse development.
* Build prototype datasets, proof-of-concept queries, and exploratory data models to support new business requirements.
* Design and develop SQL-based data marts, analytical datasets, and reusable query logic.
* Investigate undocumented databases to identify table relationships, keys, joins, business rules, and data lineage.
* Validate data outputs by applying business judgment, reconciliation techniques, and analytical reasoning.
* Identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, gaps, duplicates, and unexpected trends.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into structured SQL analysis and actionable findings.
* Partner with Product Owners, Business Systems Analysts, Data Analysts, and Data Engineering teams to clarify requirements and validate assumptions.
* Support enterprise data warehouse design by helping define source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, and analytical models.
* Document findings, data relationships, assumptions, and reusable query patterns for future team use.
* Mentor other team members on advanced SQL analysis, data investigation, and validation techniques.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of hands-on SQL development and data analysis experience.
* Strong experience working with enterprise databases, data warehouses, data marts, and analytical datasets.
* Expert-level SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregation logic, performance tuning, and query optimization.
* Proven ability to investigate unfamiliar databases and infer relationships without complete documentation.
* Strong data intuition: ability to recognize when results are incomplete, duplicated, inflated, missing, or logically incorrect.
* Experience building prototype datasets or analytical models from raw operational source data.
* Strong understanding of data warehouse concepts, dimensional modeling, fact and dimension structures, and source-to-target mapping.
* Ability to work with ambiguous requirements and independently drive analysis toward clear conclusions.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain data findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in enterprise data warehouse environments.
* Experience with healthcare, legal, financial, or other complex operational data domains.
* Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and modern data platforms.
* Experience supporting BI/reporting teams with curated datasets and data marts.
* Experience documenting data lineage, transformation rules, and business logic
* Exposure to tools such as SQL Server, Azure SQL, Snowflake, Databricks, Synapse, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Why Join Us:

+ Be part of a collaborative and innovative work environment.
+ Opportunity for professional growth and development.
+ Competitive salary and benefits package.
+ Contribute to shaping the future of our software development processes.

**Consilio’s True North Values**

title: Enterprise Integrations Analyst*
description:
**Description**
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Snowflake / Data Engineer with deep expertise in building scalable, reliable, and high-performance data platforms using Snowflake and AWS.The ideal candidate has strong experience designing production-grade data pipelines, developing complex transformations, modeling enterprise data, optimizing Snowflake workloads, and integrating data from systems such as Salesforce, APIs, SaaS platforms, and AWS services.This role will be responsible for building the data foundation that powers analytics, operational workflows, enterprise integrations, reporting, and AI applications.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Snowflake Engineering
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data solutions on Snowflake
* Develop databases, schemas, tables, views, secure views, stages, and other Snowflake objects
* Build production-grade SQL and Snowpark-based transformations
* Implement Snowflake Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe, and related capabilities
* Design incremental processing and change-data-capture patterns
* Optimize Snowflake queries, warehouses, clustering strategies, and storage patterns
* Monitor and optimize Snowflake compute consumption and platform costs
* Implement secure data-sharing and access patterns

Data Pipeline Development
  
  

* Build robust ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and semi-structured data
* Develop batch, incremental, near-real-time, and event-driven ingestion pipelines
* Integrate data from Salesforce, REST APIs, SaaS applications, AWS, databases, and file-based sources
* Implement reusable ingestion and transformation frameworks
* Build pipelines capable of handling schema evolution, late-arriving data, retries, and replay
* Develop reconciliation processes to ensure source-to-target completeness and accuracy
* Build orchestration workflows with appropriate dependency and failure management

Data Modeling
  
  

* Design scalable analytical and operational data models
* Build dimensional models, fact and dimension tables, data marts, and curated datasets
* Translate complex source-system structures into standardized enterprise data models
* Establish consistent definitions for core business entities and metrics
* Design data layers that support analytics, reporting, operational applications, and AI workloads
* Balance performance, usability, maintainability, and storage efficiency in data-model design

Salesforce Data Integration
  
  

* Build reliable pipelines ingesting Salesforce objects and related data into Snowflake
* Work with Salesforce APIs, Bulk API, Change Data Capture, and Platform Events where appropriate
* Handle Salesforce relationships, custom objects, schema changes, and large-volume datasets
* Build incremental and CDC-based synchronization patterns
* Implement reconciliation and data-quality controls between Salesforce and Snowflake

AWS Integration
  
  

* Build data pipelines using AWS services such as S3, Lambda, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, and related technologies
* Design secure data movement between AWS and Snowflake
* Build event-driven ingestion and processing workflows
* Manage file-based ingestion, staging, and archival patterns
* Implement appropriate IAM, encryption, secrets management, and access controls

Data Quality & Observability
  
  

* Implement automated data-quality validation and testing
* Build monitoring for pipeline freshness, completeness, accuracy, and failures
* Implement logging, metrics, alerts, and operational dashboards
* Establish source-to-target reconciliation processes
* Investigate and resolve production data incidents
* Identify upstream and downstream impacts of data changes

Performance & Cost Optimization
  
  

* Analyze query profiles and optimize expensive Snowflake workloads
* Optimize warehouse sizing, auto-suspend, auto-resume, and workload isolation
* Improve SQL performance and data-processing efficiency
* Monitor storage and compute consumption
* Identify opportunities to reduce pipeline runtime and infrastructure cost

Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Write clean, reusable, testable, and maintainable code
* Participate in architecture and code reviews
* Build automated testing into data pipelines
* Maintain technical documentation, data mappings, and runbooks
* Contribute to CI/CD and automated deployment practices
* Mentor other Data Engineers and help establish engineering standards

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of data engineering experience
* 3+ years of strong hands-on Snowflake experience
* Advanced SQL skills, including complex transformations and query optimization
* Strong Python skills for data processing, automation, and API integrations
* Experience building production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines
* Experience integrating Snowflake with AWS
* Experience ingesting data from Salesforce or similar enterprise SaaS platforms
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling and modern data architecture
* Experience with incremental processing, CDC, and data reconciliation
* Experience implementing data-quality and monitoring frameworks
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, and software engineering best practices

* Experience with Snowpark
* Experience with Snowflake Cortex

 The
 **EnergyIP System Engineer**

**Responsibilities**
* Provide technical expertise for EnergyIP MDM implementation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, and production support.

* Support EnergyIP customizations, enhancements, deployments, upgrades, patches, and release activities.

**Qualification \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 7\+ years of experience in MDM, enterprise application engineering, utility technology, or production support.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on EnergyIP/MDM experience preferred.
* Experience in electricity, gas, or water utility environments is preferred.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of EnergyIP MDM platform and its components.
* Strong knowledge of Java with working knowledge of Python and Shell scripting.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle SQL/PLSQL and RDBMS concepts.
* Working knowledge of Kafka/Confluent Kafka, KRaft, and ActiveMQ.
* Strong RHEL/Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, web services, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Working knowledge of security certificate.
* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Kibana, and/or Elasticsearch.
* Working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure is preferred.
* Good understanding of enterprise architecture, design principles, integration patterns, scalability, high availability, and system troubleshooting.
* Experience with CI/CD and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools such as Git, Harness, Terraform, or CloudFormation is an advantage.
